body.name: app
body.title: App
body.description: Tasks that define Kestra Enterprise Apps for interacting with flows and executions through custom layouts.
body.body: The Execution App renders bespoke pages for a flow using blocks, dispatchers, and streamers; provide `flowId` (and optional revision or `executionId`) plus a `layout` describing the components. Apps run with EE access control, can auto-load or create executions, and let teams expose curated interactions without giving full UI access.

body.name: ee
body.title: EE plugins and tasks
body.description: Tasks that extend Kestra Enterprise with governance, human-in-the-loop approvals, logging, and app-building capabilities.
body.body: Use these plugins to ship execution and audit logs, enforce manual approvals, and assemble custom execution apps that leverage Kestra EE services and RBAC. Many tasks rely on EE components such as app layouts, log exporters, KV offsets, and tenant-aware access, so ensure the required credentials and permissions are configured.

body.name: flow
body.title: Flow
body.description: Tasks that pause executions until a designated user or group approves them.
body.body: Use the HumanTask to hold downstream steps while enforcing `assignment.users` or `assignment.groups`; the execution stays paused until resumed or killed via the UI or API, making it suitable for gated deployments, manual validations, or compliance checks.

body.name: core-blocks
body.title: Core App Block
body.description: Tasks that render general-purpose UI blocks used inside Kestra Apps.
body.body: These building blocks supply markdown, tables, forms, images, alerts, log/stream viewers, redirects, and interactive buttons; configure content properties such as `text`, `columns`, `actions`, or `source` depending on the block. Use them to compose App layouts, with data binding and navigation handled by the surrounding app context.

body.name: log
body.title: Log (EE)
body.description: Tasks that export execution or audit logs and manage retention across observability targets or internal storage.
body.body: LogShipper and AuditLogShipper stream logs in batches through configured `logExporters` using `offsetKey` and optional `lookbackPeriod`, while FileLogExporter writes chunked files (`format`, `maxLinesPerFile`, `logFilePrefix`) to internal storage. PurgeAuditLogs trims audit history using `endDate` with optional `namespace`, `resources`, and `types`, helping control retention and compliance.

body.name: execution-blocks
body.title: Execution App Block
body.description: Tasks that provide execution-aware blocks for Kestra Apps.
body.body: Blocks cover creating, resuming, or canceling executions, validating inputs, downloading logs, and showing inputs/outputs or task-specific data; they rely on the `Execution` App context to access execution variables and dispatch actions safely. Use them to build state-driven layouts that react to run status and expose controlled actions for operators.

body.name: http
body.title: HTTP
body.description: Tasks that interact with HTTP endpoints.
body.body: Perform requests, downloads, or webhook triggers with configurable methods, headers, authentication, and payloads; provide the target URI plus any body or query parameters, and use response handling options to store results for downstream tasks.

body.name: templating
body.title: Templating
body.description: Tasks that render dynamic task specifications from templates.
body.body: TemplatedTask lets you supply a Pebble-rendered YAML spec that is parsed and executed at runtime; provide the `spec` property with a valid runnable task definition and avoid recursive templating when composing dynamic tasks.

body.name: chart
body.title: Chart
body.description: Tasks that render dashboard charts from Kestra data sources.
body.body: Use these chart widgets to visualize metrics, executions, or flow trends in dashboards; pair them with dashboard data queries and configure aggregations, groupings, and chart options for Bar, Pie, Time Series, KPI, or Table outputs.

body.name: kv
body.title: KV
body.description: Tasks that manage key-value pairs in Kestra's KV store.
body.body: Set, get, list, version, and delete namespaced keys to share state across flows; specify the key path, value for writes, and optional namespace or TTL to control how data is stored, retrieved, and purged.

body.name: metric
body.title: Metric
body.description: Tasks that publish custom metrics from flows.
body.body: Send counters, gauges, and timing metrics to Kestra's metric store for dashboards and alerts; define the metric name, type, value, labels, and optional timestamp to record meaningful telemetry.

body.name: condition
body.title: Condition
body.description: Tasks that evaluate conditions to control flow execution or triggers.
body.body: Use these predicates to gate tasks or triggers based on time windows, calendars, execution metadata, labels, namespaces, retries, or custom expressions; configure required parameters such as allowed states, namespaces, date ranges, or JEXL expressions to return a true/false result.

body.name: debug
body.title: Debug
body.description: Tasks that emit debug output while you develop a flow.
body.body: Echo and Return help inspect variables and payloads or short-circuit execution during testing; provide the message or value to output so downstream tasks can see exactly what is being passed around.

body.name: namespace
body.title: Namespace
body.description: Tasks that manage namespace files and versions.
body.body: Upload, download, delete, purge, or version files stored in a namespace—useful for shipping assets or configs with flows; set the target namespace, paths or glob patterns, and purge behavior to control stored artifacts.

body.name: flow
body.title: Flow
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate control flow within a Kestra pipeline.
body.body: Sequence, branch, loop, parallelize, or nest subflows/templates using these primitives; define embedded task lists, values for switches, iteration collections, working directories, and loop exit criteria to structure complex workflows cleanly.

body.name: output
body.title: Output
body.description: Tasks that expose outputs from a flow.
body.body: Use OutputValues to publish key-value outputs for downstream tasks or subflows; declare the output map and data types that consuming tasks should read.

body.name: trigger
body.title: Trigger
body.description: Tasks that start flows from schedules or events.
body.body: Define cron-based schedules, specific date triggers, webhooks, namespace flow triggers, or toggles; set required properties like cron expressions, webhook secrets, and target flow references to control when executions fire.

body.name: runner
body.title: Runner
body.description: Tasks that execute commands on the Kestra worker.
body.body: Run shell processes with configurable command, environment, working directory, and input/output handling; ensure commands are idempotent and set expected exit codes or resource needs when invoking external binaries.

body.name: execution
body.title: Execution
body.description: Tasks that manage the lifecycle and context of a running execution.
body.body: Use these tasks to assert expectations, set or unset variables, add labels, fail, exit, resume, or purge executions; supply required properties such as variable maps, label key/values, or retention rules before altering execution state.

body.name: core
body.title: Core Plugins and tasks
body.description: Tasks that provide Kestra's built-in orchestration, I/O, and observability capabilities.
body.body: Core plugins cover control-flow, execution management, triggers, storage, HTTP, metrics, logging, templating, and dashboard widgets; combine these foundational tasks to build reliable workflows without adding external dependencies.

body.name: data
body.title: Data
body.description: Tasks that fetch Kestra executions, flows, logs, metrics, and triggers as datasets for dashboards.
body.body: These data providers query Kestra repositories with filters and aggregations to feed dashboard charts; configure columns and fields (such as namespace, state, timestamp, or labels) plus any filters to shape the returned dataset for visualization.

body.name: log
body.title: Log
body.description: Tasks that write, fetch, or purge Kestra logs.
body.body: Emit structured log messages, retrieve stored logs, or clean up log storage; provide message content or log query filters and consider namespace or execution scoping when purging.

body.name: storage
body.title: Storage
body.description: Tasks that manipulate files in Kestra's internal storage.
body.body: Write, delete, concatenate, split, deduplicate, filter, reverse, size, or list files used by executions; provide source and target storage URIs and any encoding or line-handling options to transform stored data safely.

body.name: zenduty
body.title: Zenduty
body.description: Tasks that create incidents in Zenduty.
body.body: Use Zenduty routing keys and incident payloads (message, severity, entity) to trigger alerts from Kestra workflows and collect the API response.

body.name: twilio
body.title: Twilio
body.description: Tasks that send SMS or voice notifications through Twilio.
body.body: Provide Twilio account SID/auth token plus from/to numbers and message text (or call URL) to deliver SMS or voice calls from Kestra workflows.

body.name: telegram
body.title: Telegram
body.description: Tasks that send notifications via Telegram bots.
body.body: Set your Telegram bot token and chat ID to send messages (text or markdown) from Kestra workflows to chats or channels.

body.name: opsgenie
body.title: Opsgenie
body.description: Tasks that create alerts in Opsgenie.
body.body: Provide the Opsgenie API endpoint and integration key, along with message, priority, responders, and tags to open alerts from Kestra flows and receive response payloads.

body.name: pagerduty
body.title: Pagerduty
body.description: Tasks that send events to PagerDuty.
body.body: Provide a PagerDuty routing/integration key with summary, source, severity, and optional custom details to trigger incidents or alerts from Kestra workflows.

body.name: notifications
body.title: Notifications
body.description: Tasks that send notifications from Kestra via email, chat, paging, and alert channels.
body.body: Choose a channel task (Slack, Teams, Discord, email, SMS, Opsgenie, PagerDuty, etc.), provide the required token/URL/credentials and destination (channel, user, service key), and send templated messages or incident payloads from workflows.

body.name: mail
body.title: Mail
body.description: Tasks that send email notifications.
body.body: Configure SMTP server/port, credentials, from/to addresses, subject, and body/attachments to send emails from workflows; supports TLS/SSL settings for secure delivery.

body.name: sentry
body.title: Sentry
body.description: Tasks that send events to Sentry.
body.body: Provide the Sentry DSN and event payload (message, level, tags, extras) to capture errors or alerts in Sentry from Kestra flows.

body.name: line
body.title: Line
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to LINE messaging.
body.body: Provide the LINE channel access token and target user/group to push messages from Kestra, supporting text content and optional attributes.

body.name: squadcast
body.title: Squadcast
body.description: Tasks that create incidents in Squadcast.
body.body: Use the Squadcast event endpoint and routing key plus incident details (message, severity, source) to raise alerts from Kestra workflows and capture the response.

body.name: teams
body.title: Teams
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
body.body: Provide the Teams incoming webhook URL and message payload (text or cards) to post alerts from Kestra flows into Teams channels.

body.name: messenger
body.title: Messenger
body.description: Tasks that send notifications via Facebook Messenger.
body.body: Provide the Facebook Page access token and recipient ID to send text or template messages from workflows into Messenger conversations.

body.name: whatsapp
body.title: Whatsapp
body.description: Tasks that send WhatsApp messages (via Twilio API).
body.body: Use Twilio WhatsApp credentials with from/to numbers and message content to push WhatsApp notifications from Kestra workflows.

body.name: google
body.title: Google
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Google Chat.
body.body: Provide the Google Chat webhook URL and message text (or cards) to post notifications from Kestra into Chat rooms.

body.name: sendgrid
body.title: Sendgrid
body.description: Tasks that send email via SendGrid.
body.body: Set the SendGrid API key, from/to addresses, subject, and content (plus optional templates and attachments) to deliver emails through SendGrid from Kestra workflows.

body.name: discord
body.title: Discord
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Discord via webhooks.
body.body: Provide the Discord webhook URL and message content (optionally embeds/username/avatar) to post alerts from workflows into Discord channels.

body.name: x
body.title: X
body.description: Tasks that post messages to X (formerly Twitter).
body.body: Provide X API credentials and post content to publish tweets from Kestra workflows, handling auth and response payloads.

body.name: zulip
body.title: Zulip
body.description: Tasks that send messages to Zulip streams or users.
body.body: Provide Zulip server URL, email/API key, stream/topic or user targets, and message content to post notifications from Kestra workflows.

body.name: slack
body.title: Slack
body.description: Tasks that send messages to Slack.
body.body: Provide the Slack webhook URL or bot token with channel/user targets and message text or blocks to post notifications or alerts from Kestra workflows.

body.name: webhook
body.title: n8n Webhooks
body.description: Tasks that call n8n webhook endpoints to start workflows.
body.body: Provide the n8n webhook URL, HTTP method/body/headers, and optional authentication to invoke n8n flows and relay responses back into Kestra.

body.name: docker
body.title: Docker Task Runner
body.description: Run a task in a Docker container.
body.body: This task runner executes tasks in a container-based Docker-compatible engine.

body.name: vectorwise
body.title: Actian Vector (VectorWise)
body.description: Tasks that connect to Actian Vector (VectorWise)  via JDBC to run queries and loads.
body.body: Provide the Actian Vector (VectorWise)  JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

body.name: new-relic
body.title: New Relic (EE)
body.description: Tasks that ship Kestra logs to New Relic's Logs API for centralized monitoring.
body.body: Use the LogExporter tasks to forward buffered log records over HTTPS to New Relic; set `basePath` to your New Relic log ingest endpoint and provide an `apiKey` (license or ingest key). Tune optional HTTP `options` and the `chunk` size to control batching, retries, and throughput.

body.name: plugin-julia
body.title: Julia
body.description: Tasks that run Julia scripts.
body.body: Provide Julia code or files with package requirements and arguments to execute via Julia, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated artifacts from workflows.

body.name: openai
body.title: OpenAI
body.description: Tasks that call OpenAI for chat completions, images, and file uploads.
body.body: Set your OpenAI API key (and optional base URL/org) plus model names to generate chat responses, create images, or upload files for fine-tuning, returning results and usage details for downstream steps.

body.name: weaviate
body.title: Weaviate
body.description: Tasks that manage and query vectors in Weaviate.
body.body: Provide Weaviate endpoint and API key to create schemas, import vectors with properties, run similarity or hybrid searches, and delete objects, enabling vector search inside workflows.

body.name: template
body.title: Template
body.description: Plugin template for Kestra

body.name: records
body.title: Airtable Records
body.description: Tasks that read and write Airtable records: list rows with filters, views, and pagination, fetch a record by ID, create single or batched records with optional typecasting, patch updates, and deletes.
body.body: Use API key authentication and choose fetch/store outputs depending on whether you want data in-flow or stored.

body.name: d1
body.title: Cloudflare D1
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare D1 serverless SQLite databases and run SQL against them.
body.body: Create, retrieve, list, and delete D1 databases. Execute parameterized SQL queries with configurable fetch modes (FETCH_ONE, FETCH, STORE, NONE), run raw column-oriented queries, export full SQL dumps to Kestra internal storage, and import SQL files back into a database.

body.name: kv
body.title: Cloudflare Workers KV
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Workers KV key-value storage.
body.body: Bulk write and retrieve key-value pairs within Workers KV namespaces for feature flags, edge configuration, distributed state, and application-level automation.

body.name: airtable
body.title: Airtable
body.description: Tasks that connect to Airtable bases and tables over the REST API for workflow automation.
body.body: Provides record CRUD operations with formula filtering, view-aware pagination, batch handling, typecasting, and outputs suited to AI Agent workflows.

body.name: cache
body.title: Cloudflare Cache
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare cache operations.
body.body: Purge entire zone cache or specific cached files and URLs. Automate cache invalidation workflows securely using Cloudflare API tokens.

body.name: workers
body.title: Cloudflare Workers
body.description: Tasks that interact with Cloudflare Workers: run inline code via Dynamic Workers and manage Worker scripts as resources.
body.body: Includes the Dynamic Workers subpackage (`workers.dynamic.Run`) for running inline code on the edge via the Worker Loader binding, and the Worker Scripts subpackage (`workers.scripts.*`) for managing scripts on an account.

body.name: namespaces
body.title: Cloudflare Workers KV Namespaces
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Workers KV namespaces.
body.body: Create Workers KV namespaces to organize and isolate key-value storage within a Cloudflare account. Enables structured edge data management for scalable applications.

body.name: cloudflare
body.title: Cloudflare
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare zones, DNS records, cache, Workers, and D1 databases.
body.body: Create, update, list, and delete Cloudflare zones and DNS records. Purge zone cache, deploy and manage Worker scripts, run inline code on the edge via Dynamic Workers, and manage D1 serverless SQLite databases including SQL queries and exports. Automate Cloudflare infrastructure operations securely using API tokens.

body.name: zones
body.title: Cloudflare Zones
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare zones.
body.body: Retrieve and list Cloudflare zones and inspect domain-level configuration securely using Cloudflare API tokens.

body.name: dynamic
body.title: Cloudflare Dynamic Workers
body.description: Tasks that run inline code on a gateway Cloudflare Worker using the Dynamic Workers (Worker Loader) binding.
body.body: POST inline JavaScript or TypeScript source to a user-deployed gateway Worker that calls `env.LOADER.load(...)` to execute the code on the edge. The gateway URL is the auth boundary; the task does not require an API token or account ID.

body.name: accessrules
body.title: Cloudflare IP Access Rules
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare IP Access Rules.
body.body: Create, delete, and list IP Access Rules at the account or zone level. Control traffic by blocking, challenging, or allowing IP addresses, IP ranges, ASNs, and countries to automate security and threat response workflows.

body.name: scripts
body.title: Cloudflare Worker Scripts
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare Worker scripts as resources via the Workers Scripts REST API.
body.body: Deploy, list, get, and delete Cloudflare Worker scripts on an account. Companion to `io.kestra.plugin.cloudflare.workers.dynamic.Run`, which invokes inline code through a gateway Worker.

body.name: records
body.title: Cloudflare DNS Records
body.description: Tasks that manage Cloudflare DNS records.
body.body: Create, retrieve, update, delete, list, batch, and upsert DNS records within Cloudflare zones. Supports common record types such as A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, and more for full DNS automation.

body.name: bluesky
body.title: Bluesky
body.description: Tasks that post messages to Bluesky (AT Protocol).
body.body: Provide Bluesky credentials and post content to publish skeets from Kestra workflows, handling authentication and response payloads via the AT Protocol API.

body.name: snapshot
body.title: Proxmox VE Snapshots
body.description: Tasks that create, delete, list, and roll back snapshots for QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE.
body.body: Specify node, resource type, VMID, and snapshot name to manage point-in-time state. Rollback reverts the machine to a named snapshot; List returns all snapshots for a given resource.

body.name: proxmox
body.title: Proxmox VE
body.description: Tasks that manage the full lifecycle of QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE, including backups, snapshots, cluster introspection, and network inspection.
body.body: Provide host, port, node, and either a username/password pair or an API token to authenticate. Covers VM and container lifecycle (create, start, stop, clone, migrate, delete), backup and snapshot management, cluster and pool introspection, network interface and firewall inspection, template management, and async task polling via UPID.

body.name: vm
body.title: Proxmox VE VM
body.description: Tasks that create, start, stop, reboot, reset, clone, migrate, update, delete, and list QEMU virtual machines on a Proxmox VE node.
body.body: Provide the node name, VMID, and connection details. Most write operations return a UPID for async tracking, which can be polled with the task.WaitForTask step. Includes a polling trigger that fires when a VM reaches a target status.

body.name: template
body.title: Proxmox VE Templates
body.description: Tasks that convert a stopped VM or container into a template and list available templates on a Proxmox VE node.
body.body: Specify node, resource type, and VMID to convert a stopped machine to a reusable template. List returns all templates available for cloning on a given node.

body.name: backup
body.title: Proxmox VE Backup
body.description: Tasks that create, restore, and list backups for QEMU VMs and LXC containers on Proxmox VE.
body.body: Specify node, resource type (vm or container), and VMID to trigger a vzdump backup or restore from a storage path. List returns all backups available on the node for a given storage target.

body.name: cluster
body.title: Proxmox VE Cluster
body.description: Tasks that query node status, list cluster-wide resources, and list storage pools on a Proxmox VE cluster.
body.body: No specific node is required for cluster-scope queries. Returns JSON representations of node metrics, resource inventory across all nodes, and pool definitions.

body.name: task
body.title: Proxmox VE Tasks
body.description: Tasks that poll and wait for async Proxmox VE operations identified by a UPID.
body.body: Pass a UPID returned by any write operation to GetTaskStatus for a single status check, or to WaitForTask to block until the operation completes or a timeout is reached.

body.name: network
body.title: Proxmox VE Network
body.description: Tasks that list network interfaces and fetch firewall rules for a Proxmox VE node.
body.body: Provide the node name to list host-level network interfaces, or provide a VMID and resource type to fetch per-machine firewall rule sets.

body.name: container
body.title: Proxmox VE Containers
body.description: Tasks that create, start, stop, reboot, clone, migrate, update, delete, and list LXC containers on a Proxmox VE node.
body.body: Provide the node name, VMID, and connection details. Most write operations return a UPID for async tracking, which can be polled with the task.WaitForTask step.

body.name: tika
body.title: Apache Tika
body.description: Tasks that extract text and metadata from files using Apache Tika.
body.body: Provide input files to detect content type and extract text or metadata across many formats (PDF, Office, images, etc.), returning parsed content for further processing in workflows.

body.name: jms
body.title: JMS
body.description: Tasks that produce, consume, and trigger workflows from JMS queues or topics.
body.body: Configure the JMS connection factory (broker URL, credentials, client ID) and destination name to publish messages, consume with polling or real-time triggers, and control serialization and acknowledgement so Kestra can coordinate with ActiveMQ, Artemis, or any JMS-compliant broker.

body.name: plugin-groovy
body.title: Groovy
body.description: Tasks that run Groovy scripts.
body.body: Provide Groovy code inline or script files with optional dependencies and JVM options to execute via Groovy, capturing stdout/stderr and generated files.

body.name: plugin-bun
body.title: Bun
body.description: Tasks that run Bun scripts.
body.body: Provide inline Bun/JavaScript code or script files with optional packages and arguments to execute via Bun, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream steps.

body.name: plugin-deno
body.title: Deno
body.description: Tasks that run Deno scripts.
body.body: Provide TypeScript/JavaScript code inline or files with permissions, imports, and arguments to execute via Deno, capturing stdout/stderr and output files from workflows.

body.name: plugin-go
body.title: Go
body.description: Tasks that run Go code.
body.body: Provide Go code inline or files with modules and build/run arguments to compile or execute Go programs within Kestra, capturing logs and outputs.

body.name: plugin-dotnet
body.title: .NET (C#)
body.description: Tasks that run .NET C# scripts using dotnet-script.
body.body: Provide C# code inline as .csx scripts or run arbitrary dotnet CLI commands inside a .NET SDK container, capturing stdout/stderr and any output files for subsequent steps.

body.name: plugin-jbang
body.title: JBang
body.description: Tasks that run Java code with JBang.
body.body: Provide Java code inline or source files with dependencies and JBang options to compile and run via JBang from Kestra, capturing outputs for downstream steps.

body.name: plugin-julia
body.title: Julia
body.description: Tasks that run Julia scripts.
body.body: Provide Julia code inline or files with package requirements and arguments to execute via Julia, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated artifacts from workflows.

body.name: plugin-php
body.title: PHP
body.description: Tasks that run PHP scripts.
body.body: Provide PHP code inline or files with dependencies and arguments to execute via PHP in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated files.

body.name: plugin-powershell
body.title: PowerShell
body.description: Tasks that run PowerShell scripts.
body.body: Provide PowerShell code inline or ps1 files with arguments to execute via PowerShell, capturing stdout/stderr and any output files for subsequent steps.

body.name: plugin-jython
body.title: Jython
body.description: Tasks that run Python scripts with the Jython interpreter.
body.body: Provide Python code inline or files to execute on the JVM via Jython with optional dependencies and arguments, capturing outputs for downstream processing.

body.name: plugin-perl
body.title: Perl
body.description: Tasks that run Perl scripts.
body.body: Provide Perl code inline or script files with arguments to execute via Perl in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and output files.

body.name: plugin-node
body.title: Node
body.description: Tasks that run Node.js scripts.
body.body: Provide JavaScript/TypeScript code inline or files with npm packages and arguments to run via Node.js, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream steps.

body.name: plugin-lua
body.title: Lua
body.description: Tasks that run Lua scripts.
body.body: Provide Lua code inline or script files and arguments to execute via the Lua runtime in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and outputs.

body.name: plugin-python
body.title: Python
body.description: Tasks that run Python scripts with optional dependencies.
body.body: Provide Python code inline or files, pip requirements, interpreter options, and arguments to execute via Python in Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream tasks.

body.name: plugin-nashorn
body.title: Nashorn
body.description: Tasks that run JavaScript with the Nashorn engine.
body.body: Provide JavaScript code inline or script files to execute via Nashorn on the JVM, with optional bindings and arguments, capturing outputs for workflows.

body.name: plugin-ruby
body.title: Ruby
body.description: Tasks that run Ruby scripts.
body.body: Provide Ruby code inline or files with gem dependencies and arguments to execute via Ruby, capturing stdout/stderr and any generated files for later steps.

body.name: plugin-shell
body.title: Shell
body.description: Tasks that run shell commands or scripts.
body.body: Provide shell commands or script files with interpreter options and environment settings to execute on the worker, capturing stdout/stderr and output files for downstream tasks.

body.name: plugin-r
body.title: R
body.description: Tasks that run R scripts.
body.body: Provide R code inline or script files with package installs and arguments to execute via R, capturing stdout/stderr and outputs (including plots/files) for workflows.

body.name: netbox-ipam
body.title: NetBox IPAM
body.description: Tasks for IP address management in NetBox.
body.body: Assign IP addresses to devices and interfaces in NetBox, with support for allocating from prefixes.

body.name: airbyte
body.title: Airbyte
body.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Airbyte sync and reset jobs in self-hosted Airbyte and Airbyte Cloud
body.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate Airbyte connection jobs from Kestra, including starting syncs, running resets, and waiting for job completion. Choose the self-hosted connection tasks or the Airbyte Cloud job tasks based on your Airbyte deployment and authentication model.

body.name: connections
body.title: Airbyte Connections
body.description: Tasks that start and monitor sync jobs on a self-hosted Airbyte instance
body.body: Use these tasks to trigger a connection sync and optionally wait for the Airbyte job to finish. Set `url` and the required connection or job ID, then configure one supported authentication method such as basic auth, a bearer token, or application credentials.

body.name: netbox
body.title: NetBox (EE)
body.description: Enterprise NetBox tasks to create, update, and query devices, IP addresses, and sites over the NetBox API.
body.body: Automate NetBox inventory: register or edit devices, allocate or assign IPs, and list sites or devices with filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output for bulk results.

body.name: netbox-contact-assignment
body.title: NetBox Contact Assignment
body.description: Tasks for creating and listing contact assignments in NetBox.
body.body: Create and list contact assignments in NetBox, linking contacts and roles to resources such as devices and sites.

body.name: netbox-device
body.title: NetBox Device
body.description: Tasks for creating, updating, and listing devices in NetBox.
body.body: Create, update, and list device records in NetBox with support for filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output.

body.name: netbox-site
body.title: NetBox Site
body.description: Tasks for listing sites in NetBox.
body.body: List site records in NetBox with support for filters, field selection, pagination, and internal storage output.

body.name: jobs
body.title: Airbyte Cloud Jobs
body.description: Tasks that create and monitor Airbyte Cloud jobs for a connection
body.body: Use these tasks to run sync or reset jobs in Airbyte Cloud and, by default, wait for completion. Provide the `connectionId` and one supported authentication method such as a bearer token, client credentials, or basic auth.

body.name: batch
body.title: AWS Batch
body.description: Tasks for running jobs on AWS Batch.
body.body: Submits a job to an existing AWS Batch job queue using an existing job definition (pure orchestration, no resource creation). Provide `region` with AWS credentials or an assumed role, plus `jobQueue` and `jobDefinition`. Override `parameters`, `containerCommand`, or `containerEnvironment` per run, tune completion polling and `maxWait`, and enable `streamLogs` to forward CloudWatch job logs into Kestra.

body.name: s3
body.title: Amazon S3 Log Exporter
body.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to Amazon S3 for durable storage and downstream analysis.
body.body: Provide `region` and a target `bucket` with AWS credentials or an assumed role; choose JSON or ION format, control file naming with `logFilePrefix`, and tune `chunk`/`maxLinesPerFile` to manage upload batches and file sizes while capturing upload metrics.

body.name: runner
body.title: AWS Task Runners
body.description: Task runners that run Kestra workloads on AWS Batch (ECS Fargate/EC2 or EKS compute environments) or natively on a plain EC2 instance.
body.body: `Batch` requires `computeEnvironmentArn` (and typically `jobQueueArn`) plus AWS credentials or an assumed role. Set a `bucket` when using `inputFiles`, `outputFiles`, or working directory sync, and ensure the task defines a `containerImage`. On ECS, tune `executionRoleArn` and `taskRoleArn` as needed. On EKS those roles are ignored and IAM access is granted through `serviceAccountName` with IRSA. Resources, polling, and resume/cleanup options can be tuned to fit your Batch environment. `Ec2` ignores `containerImage`: it launches a plain instance from `amiId` and runs task commands natively via AWS Systems Manager Run Command, requiring an `iamInstanceProfile` granting SSM access and an AMI with the SSM Agent installed.

body.name: cloudwatch
body.title: Amazon CloudWatch Log Exporter
body.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs for centralized monitoring.
body.body: Configure `region`, `logGroupName`, and `logStreamName` along with AWS credentials or an assumed role to push execution logs in batches; adjust `chunk` to balance throughput and CloudWatch API usage while emitting request and log counters.

body.name: emr
body.title: AWS EMR
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate Amazon EMR and EMR Serverless workloads: create or delete clusters, submit steps, start job runs, and optionally wait for completion so Spark or Hadoop pipelines can be managed from Kestra.

body.name: msk
body.title: AWS MSK
body.description: Tasks to manage Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka) cluster lifecycle and retrieve bootstrap broker connection strings for use with plugin-kafka.

body.name: aws
body.title: AWS (EE)
body.description: Tasks that integrate AWS services into Kestra enterprise workflows including task runners and log management.
body.body: Provides AWS Batch task execution and log export to Amazon S3 and CloudWatch Logs; configure each task with an AWS region and credentials or an assumed role, plus the service-specific target such as a Batch compute environment, an S3 bucket, or a CloudWatch log group.

body.name: s3
body.title: AWS S3
body.description: Tasks that manage Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) buckets and objects.
body.body: Upload or download single and multiple files, list, copy, and delete keys, create buckets, and trigger flows from bucket events. Supports streaming files from URIs, writing fetched objects to outputs, and handling large transfers via the S3 Transfer Manager.

body.name: ecr
body.title: AWS ECR
body.description: Tasks that fetch an Amazon ECR authorization token for Docker or OCI registry logins, useful before building or pulling images in workflows.

body.name: cli
body.title: AWS CLI
body.description: Tasks that run AWS CLI commands (inside a container by default), reuse Kestra credentials and environment variables, and capture stdout or files produced by the CLI.

body.name: auth
body.title: AWS Authentication
body.description: Tasks that generate authentication material for AWS services, such as short-lived tokens to access Amazon EKS clusters.

body.name: kinesis
body.title: AWS Kinesis
body.description: Tasks and triggers for Amazon Kinesis Data Streams: write batches of records with partition keys, consume records, and start flows on new records via polling or realtime triggers.

body.name: dynamodb
body.title: AWS DynamoDB
body.description: Tasks that read and write Amazon DynamoDB tables: put, get, or delete individual items and run query or scan operations with expression attributes.
body.body: Supports limiting and filtering results, then fetching rows directly or storing them to files for downstream steps.

body.name: sns
body.title: AWS SNS
body.description: Tasks that publish notifications to Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topics for pub/sub fanout or SMS, email, Lambda, and SQS targets, with support for custom message attributes.

body.name: sqs
body.title: AWS SQS
body.description: Tasks that publish to or consume from Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), including polling and real-time triggers.
body.body: Use them to push messages, drain queues into flow outputs, or start flows when new messages arrive.

body.name: aws
body.title: AWS
body.description: Tasks and triggers that integrate Amazon Web Services with Kestra workflows, spanning storage (S3, DynamoDB), analytics (Athena, EMR, Glue), messaging and streaming (SNS, SQS, Kinesis, MSK, EventBridge), compute (Lambda, CLI), infrastructure (CloudFormation, ECR), monitoring (CloudWatch), authentication (EKS tokens), AI (Bedrock), and healthcare data (HealthLake).
body.body: Authenticate every task and trigger with static credentials (`accessKeyId` and `secretKeyId`, optionally a `sessionToken`), by assuming an IAM role through `stsRoleArn`, or by relying on the default AWS credentials provider chain when none are set. Set `region` for the target service, and override `endpointOverride` with `compatibilityMode` enabled to reach S3-compatible storage backends.

body.name: athena
body.title: AWS Athena
body.description: Tasks that run Amazon Athena SQL queries against data in S3 or federated sources, writing results to an S3 output location and optionally fetching rows.
body.body: Queries can wait for completion or be submitted asynchronously and emit execution metrics such as data scanned to help monitor cost.

body.name: lambda
body.title: AWS Lambda
body.description: Tasks that invoke AWS Lambda functions with optional JSON payloads, capture response bodies or logs, and emit metrics about execution time and payload size for serverless workflows.

body.name: bedrock
body.title: AWS Bedrock
body.description: Tasks that invoke foundation models on Amazon Bedrock, run structured multi-turn conversations via the unified Converse API, stream responses, and list available models — all using the same AWS credentials as the rest of your plugin-aws stack.

body.name: files
body.title: AWS S3 Files
body.description: Tasks for managing Amazon S3 Files file systems and mount targets (S3 buckets mountable as NFS v4.1+ file systems).

body.name: glue
body.title: AWS Glue
body.description: Tasks that control AWS Glue jobs: start runs with arguments, monitor their status, stop executions, and fetch job metadata to orchestrate serverless Spark ETL pipelines.

body.name: cloudwatch
body.title: AWS CloudWatch
body.description: Tasks that push custom metrics, query recent CloudWatch metric statistics, and trigger flows when metric queries return data.
body.body: These tasks provide lightweight observability hooks without managing agents.

body.name: cloudformation
body.title: AWS CloudFormation
body.description: Tasks that create, update, or delete AWS CloudFormation stacks and optionally wait for stack operations to finish, returning stack outputs for downstream use.

body.name: healthlake
body.title: AWS HealthLake
body.description: Tasks to manage Amazon HealthLake FHIR R4 data stores and orchestrate bulk import and export jobs as part of healthcare data pipelines.

body.name: eventbridge
body.title: AWS EventBridge
body.description: Tasks that put events on Amazon EventBridge buses with custom detail payloads so routing rules can fan them out to downstream AWS or SaaS targets.

body.name: opensearch
body.title: OpenSearch (EE)
body.description: Tasks that connect to OpenSearch over HTTP for indexing and log export.
body.body: Use these tasks to push execution logs or other documents into OpenSearch indices via bulk REST calls. Provide one or more host URLs (with scheme and port) and the target index name; optional basic auth, custom headers, path prefix, and TLS trust-all assist with secured or proxied clusters.

body.name: opensearch
body.title: OpenSearch
body.description: Tasks that load, search, and manage data in OpenSearch clusters.
body.body: Configure OpenSearch hosts with optional basic auth or headers, then run load/bulk/index operations and search or scroll queries against specific indices; routing, refresh policies, HTTP methods, and path prefixes are exposed for fine-grained control.

body.name: esxi
body.title: ESXi VMs and Snapshots
body.description: Tasks that manage VM lifecycle, snapshots, reconfiguration, and event triggers on a single ESXi host.
body.body: Connect to the ESXi host (port 443 by default) with credentials and optional trust store. Provide VM names and network/datastore/ISO details to create, power, snapshot, or restore VMs when vCenter is unavailable.

body.name: cloudrun
body.title: Google Cloud Run
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate existing Google Cloud Run Jobs from a Kestra flow.
body.body: Use this task to submit an execution against a Cloud Run Job that already exists, wait for its completion, and stream its container logs back into the flow. Provide projectId, region, and jobName plus a service account or impersonated identity; use containerArgs, containerEnvironment, and taskCount to override the Job template for a single execution.

body.name: runner
body.title: Google Cloud Task Runner
body.description: Tasks that run and orchestrate Kestra workloads on Google Cloud Run, Batch, and Compute Engine.
body.body: Use these runners when you need managed container execution or a Compute Engine VM with log streaming and file staging. Set a containerImage on the task for Cloud Run/Batch (or instanceConfig/instanceName for Compute Engine), provide projectId and region/zone plus a service account or impersonated identity, and configure a Cloud Storage bucket when passing inputFiles/namespaceFiles or collecting outputFiles.

body.name: operationalsuite
body.title: Cloud Operations Suite Log Exporter
body.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Google Cloud Operations (Logging) for centralized observability.
body.body: Use the log exporter to push workflow logs with severity and labels into Cloud Logging so they can feed dashboards, alerts, and audits. Configure projectId along with a service account or impersonated identity, and adjust the chunk size to balance throughput with rate limits.

body.name: gcs
body.title: Cloud Storage Log Exporter
body.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to Google Cloud Storage for durable archiving.
body.body: Leverage the log exporter to stream workflow logs into a GCS bucket as JSON or ION with configurable file prefixes, chunking, and max lines per file. Provide projectId and bucket, optionally set service account or impersonation, and tune format, logFilePrefix, maxLinesPerFile, and chunk to match your retention or downstream analytics needs.

body.name: gcp
body.title: Google Cloud (EE)
body.description: Tasks that integrate Google Cloud Platform services into Kestra enterprise workflows including task runners and log management.
body.body: Provides task execution on Google Cloud Run and Batch and log export to Cloud Storage and the Cloud Operations Suite; configure each task with a project ID and credentials via a service account or impersonated identity, plus the service-specific target such as a Cloud Run or Batch region, a Cloud Storage bucket, or Cloud Logging.

body.name: soda
body.title: Soda
body.description: Tasks that run Soda scans for data quality checks.
body.body: Provide Soda configuration and `checks` YAML along with any required connectors or variables to execute scans (deprecated Soda Core 3, via `Scan`) or verify data contracts (Soda Core 4, via `VerifyContract`), emitting check outcomes and results files you can inspect or fail pipelines on.

body.name: vcenter
body.title: VMware vCenter VMs and Templates
body.description: Tasks that manage VM lifecycle, cloning, template conversion, snapshots, and event triggers through vCenter.
body.body: Use these tasks with a vCenter server (port 443 by default), credentials, and optional trust store. Supply datacenter/host/network/datastore/ISO details as required to clone or create VMs, convert templates, control power state, and manage snapshots across clusters.

body.name: vmware
body.title: VMware (EE)
body.description: Tasks that automate VMware vSphere operations within Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate VM lifecycle, snapshotting, and template management across ESXi and vCenter from a single flow. Configure each task with your vSphere endpoint, credentials, and optional trust store so runs can safely manage infrastructure as part of data or CI/CD pipelines.

body.name: payment
body.title: Stripe Payment
body.description: Tasks that create and manage Stripe payments or charges.
body.body: Set your Stripe API key with amounts, currency, customer/payment method IDs, and optional metadata to create charges or payment intents and retrieve their status for order workflows.

body.name: webhook
body.title: Stripe Webhook
body.description: Tasks that process Stripe webhook events.
body.body: Configure the webhook signing secret to validate incoming Stripe events, parse payloads, and trigger workflows with event data such as payment updates or subscription changes.

body.name: stripe
body.title: Stripe
body.description: Tasks that interact with Stripe customers, payments, balances, and webhooks.
body.body: Provide your Stripe API key and relevant IDs to create or retrieve customers, charge or refund payments, check balances, and process webhook events using signing secrets for secure automation.

body.name: balance
body.title: Stripe Balance
body.description: Tasks that fetch Stripe balances and payouts.
body.body: Set your Stripe API key to retrieve current balance and payout details, returning amounts by currency for finance workflows.

body.name: cli
body.title: Terragrunt CLI
body.description: Tasks that run Terragrunt CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
body.body: Run Terragrunt commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

body.name: terragrunt
body.title: Terragrunt
body.description: Tasks that run Terragrunt CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
body.body: Run Terragrunt commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

body.name: telegram
body.title: Telegram
body.description: Tasks that send notifications via Telegram bots.
body.body: Set your Telegram bot token and chat ID to send messages (text or markdown) from Kestra workflows to chats or channels.

body.name: zoom
body.title: Zoom
body.description: Zoom plugin for Kestra
body.body: Send notifications and messages to Zoom Team Chat channels or users directly from your Kestra workflows.

body.name: cli
body.title: Trivy
body.description: Tasks that execute arbitrary Trivy CLI commands.
body.body: Set the Trivy `commands` to run (image, filesystem, or config scans), optionally override the Trivy container image or target OS, and capture the CLI output files for vulnerability reporting in your workflows.

body.name: twilio
body.title: Twilio
body.description: Tasks that integrate with the Twilio ecosystem.
body.body: Configure authentication and service-specific parameters to interact with Twilio-powered communication and data services. These tasks enable workflows to send messages, manage communications, and connect with external customer engagement platforms supported by Twilio, all directly from Kestra.

body.name: trivy
body.title: Trivy
body.description: Tasks that run Trivy security scans through the CLI.
body.body: Execute Trivy commands against container images, filesystems, or IaC using configurable container images and capture the scan output for reporting or gating deployments.

body.name: notify
body.title: Twilio Messaging
body.description: Tasks that send SMS or voice notifications through Twilio.
body.body: Provide Twilio account SID/auth token plus from/to numbers and message text (or call URL) to deliver SMS or voice calls from Kestra workflows.

body.name: segment
body.title: Segment
body.description: Tasks that interact with Segment APIs.
body.body: Set Segment API credentials and provide relevant identifiers to perform Segment operations and retrieve API payloads for workflow automation.

body.name: spark
body.title: Apache Spark
body.description: Tasks that submit Apache Spark jobs and run Spark CLI commands.
body.body: Provide the Spark master/cluster config, application artifact (JAR, Python file, or R script), main class or entry point, and args to launch jobs with optional driver/executor settings; SparkCLI lets you run ad-hoc spark-submit commands and capture logs for orchestration.

body.name: customer
body.title: Stripe Customer
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch Stripe customers.
body.body: Provide your Stripe API key with customer attributes (email, name, metadata) to upsert customers and retrieve details for billing flows.

body.name: cloudflare
body.title: Cloudflare R2
body.description: Cloudflare R2 object storage plugin for Kestra

body.name: rcs
body.title: Twilio RCS
body.description: Tasks that send RCS messages via the Twilio Messages API.
body.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, an RCS-enabled sender, and message text or a content template SID to send RCS messages from Kestra workflows. Twilio falls back to SMS when the recipient cannot receive RCS.

body.name: mms
body.title: Twilio MMS
body.description: Tasks that send MMS messages via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API.
body.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, from/to phone numbers, and media URLs to send MMS messages from Kestra workflows.

body.name: sms
body.title: Twilio SMS
body.description: Tasks that send SMS messages via the Twilio Programmable Messaging API.
body.body: Provide Twilio account SID, auth token, and from/to phone numbers to send SMS messages from Kestra workflows.

body.name: cli
body.title: Skopeo CLI
body.description: Run Skopeo CLI commands to inspect, copy, and manage container images and registries.

body.name: skopeo
body.title: Skopeo
body.description: Plugin for interacting with container images and registries using Skopeo.

body.name: qq
body.title: Tencent QQ / IM
body.description: Tasks for sending execution-based notifications to Tencent Cloud IM / QQ.
body.body: Send execution-triggered alerts from Kestra to Tencent Cloud IM / QQ using the Tencent IM REST API. These tasks are intended for flow-trigger notifications and include execution metadata such as execution ID, namespace, flow name, status, duration, and failed task details when applicable.

body.name: reverseetl
body.title: Reverse ETL
body.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Segment Reverse ETL syncs.
body.body: Provide Segment API credentials and provide Reverse ETL identifiers to start syncs and retrieve their status for workflow automation.

body.name: scrapy
body.title: Scrapy CLI
body.description: Tasks that run Scrapy spiders and CLI commands to scrape data from websites.
body.body: Use the `CLI` task to execute `scrapy crawl`, `scrapy runspider`, and other Scrapy commands inside the pre-built `ghcr.io/kestra-io/scrapy` image.

body.name: youtube
body.title: YouTube
body.description: Tasks that interact with the YouTube Data API.
body.body: Provide API credentials and channel or video identifiers to search videos, list playlists, or manage uploads, returning metadata for content and reporting workflows.

body.name: tencent
body.title: Tencent
body.description: Tencent integrations for Kestra.
body.body: This plugin provides integrations with Tencent services. It includes tasks for sending execution-based notifications and alerts using Tencent Cloud communication platforms.

body.name: sendgrid
body.title: Sendgrid
body.description: Tasks that send email via SendGrid.
body.body: Set the SendGrid API key, from/to addresses, subject, and content (plus optional templates and attachments) to deliver emails through SendGrid from Kestra workflows.

body.name: x
body.title: X
body.description: Tasks that post messages to X (formerly Twitter).
body.body: Provide X API credentials and post content to publish tweets from Kestra workflows, handling auth and response payloads.

body.name: slack
body.title: Slack
body.description: Slack notification webhooks and full Slack App automations across chat, files, canvases, channels, reactions, users, and events.
body.body: Use either an incoming webhook `url` (https://hooks.slack.com/...) for lightweight notifications or a Slack App `token` (xoxb) plus optional `signingSecret` to run chat, conversations, files, canvases, reactions, and user tasks or trigger flows from the Event API. Supports threaded updates, streaming message sessions, channel lifecycle management, file uploads/cleanup, canvas authoring, reaction-based approvals, user lookups, and reusable output models for downstream steps.

body.name: zenduty
body.title: Zenduty
body.description: Tasks that create incidents in Zenduty.
body.body: Use Zenduty routing keys and incident payloads (message, severity, entity) to trigger alerts from Kestra workflows and collect the API response.

body.name: chats
body.title: Slack Chats
body.description: Tasks that post, update, schedule, or stream Slack chat messages.
body.body: Use a bot `token` with `chat:write` to send JSON `payload` or `messageText` to a `channel`; updates/deletes/scheduling rely on the message `timestamp`, and streaming tasks share the `streamId` and `threadTs` outputs across Start/Append/Stop. Ideal for alerts, threaded updates, or long-running progress feeds.

body.name: files
body.title: Slack Files
body.description: Tasks that upload, inspect, and delete Slack files.
body.body: Run with a bot `token` that has `files:write`; uploads need a storage `from` URI plus `filename` (and optional `channels` or thread `timestamp`), while info/delete calls take a file `id`. Use these to publish generated reports or clean up shared artifacts from flows.

body.name: models
body.title: Slack Models
body.description: Tasks that expose reusable output models for Slack app tasks.
body.body: Reference these schemas (message, file, conversation, canvas, reaction, user outputs) to know which fields are emitted by Slack tasks and safely reuse them in downstream steps; no configuration is required beyond consuming task outputs.

body.name: core
body.title: Slack App
body.description: Tasks that run Slack App workflows and triggers using bot tokens.
body.body: Provide a Slack app `token` (xoxb) for all method calls; the Event API trigger also needs the app `signingSecret` to verify requests. Use these when you need app-scoped actions or to start flows from Slack events instead of simple webhooks.

body.name: users
body.title: Slack Users
body.description: Tasks that look up Slack users, profiles, and memberships.
body.body: Use a bot `token`; fetch by `userId` or `email` for details/presence, list all users with paging, or retrieve a user's conversations for routing. Helpful for targeting alerts, enriching audit logs, or resolving emails to Slack IDs in workflows.

body.name: app
body.title: Slack App
body.description: Tasks that run Slack App workflows and triggers using bot tokens.
body.body: Provide a Slack app `token` (xoxb) for all method calls; the Event API trigger also needs the app `signingSecret` to verify requests. Use these when you need app-scoped actions or to start flows from Slack events instead of simple webhooks.

body.name: surrealdb
body.title: SurrealDB
body.description: Tasks that run SurrealQL queries against SurrealDB.
body.body: Provide SurrealDB endpoint details (namespace, database, username/password or token) and SurrealQL statements to query or mutate data, returning results and metrics for downstream workflows.

body.name: solace
body.title: Solace
body.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger workflows with Solace messaging.
body.body: Provide Solace connection details (host, VPN, username/password), topics/queues, and serializers to send messages, consume with acknowledgment options, or trigger flows when new messages arrive.

body.name: reactions
body.title: Slack Reactions
body.description: Tasks that add, remove, or fetch reactions on Slack messages.
body.body: Provide a bot `token` with reactions scopes plus the target `channel`, message `timestamp`, and emoji `name`; retrieval can return all users on a message for auditing or routing. Useful for lightweight approvals, acknowledgments, or counting engagement.

body.name: sqlmesh
body.title: SQLMesh
body.description: Tasks that run SQLMesh commands.
body.body: Provide SQLMesh project paths/configs and CLI options to plan, run, or apply SQLMesh workflows from Kestra, capturing outputs for deployment pipelines.

body.name: conversations
body.title: Slack Conversations
body.description: Tasks that manage Slack channels, DMs, and conversation history.
body.body: Requires a bot `token` with conversation scopes; supply a `channel`/`conversationId` for membership changes, renames, archiving, or topic/purpose updates, and use `cursor`/`limit` options when listing or pulling history. Useful for provisioning channels, moderating membership, or paging archives from workflows.

body.name: cli
body.title: SQLMesh CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute SQLMesh CLI commands.
body.body: Set working directory and SQLMesh configuration, then run CLI commands (plan, run, apply, etc.) with arguments, capturing stdout/stderr and artifacts for orchestration.

body.name: notifications
body.title: Slack Notifications
body.description: Tasks that post Slack notifications through incoming webhooks or execution templates.
body.body: Use an incoming webhook `url` (https://hooks.slack.com/...) with either `messageText` or JSON `payload`; SlackExecution also needs an `executionId` to render the built-in status template. Ideal for alerting flows or any external webhook endpoint that accepts Slack-compatible payloads.

body.name: shopify
body.title: Shopify
body.description: Tasks that call the Shopify Admin API to manage products, orders, and customers.
body.body: Set your store domain and Admin API access token (with API version and optional rate-limit delay) to list, create, update, or delete Shopify resources, and wire the responses into downstream fulfillment or analytics flows.

body.name: canvases
body.title: Slack Canvases
body.description: Tasks that create, edit, and secure Slack canvases.
body.body: Run with an app `token` that has canvases scopes; creation needs a `title` plus markdown `documentContent`, while updates/deletes require the target `canvasId` and relevant `sectionId`. Use these to publish documentation, adjust sections, or update access via flows.

body.name: products
body.title: Shopify Products
body.description: Tasks that list or update Shopify products.
body.body: Authenticate with your store domain and Admin API token to list products with filters (status, publication) or update product fields, using the API version and delay settings to stay within Shopify limits.

body.name: orders
body.title: Shopify Orders
body.description: Tasks that list or delete orders from Shopify.
body.body: Use the store domain and Admin API token to page through orders or remove them by ID, applying filters such as status or fulfillment state while respecting API versioning and rate limits.

body.name: zapier
body.title: Zapier
body.description: Plugin zapier for Kestra

body.name: sifflet
body.title: Sifflet
body.description: Tasks that execute data quality rules on the Sifflet platform.
body.body: Provide the Sifflet `apiKey`, `ruleId`, and optional `baseUrl` or timeout to trigger rule runs via the API and capture status codes and responses for alerting or lineage tracking.

body.name: servicenow
body.title: ServiceNow
body.description: Tasks that create, update, read, and delete ServiceNow records via REST.
body.body: Set the ServiceNow instance URL with credentials or basic auth, choose the table, and provide request bodies or sys_ids to post, update, fetch, or delete records; responses include the JSON payloads for downstream handling.

body.name: customers
body.title: Shopify Customers
body.description: Tasks that create, list, fetch, or delete Shopify customers.
body.body: Provide the store domain, Admin API token, and optional API version to manage customer records, including listing with filters or deleting by ID, while honoring Shopify rate limits between calls.

body.name: supabase
body.title: Supabase
body.description: Tasks that call Supabase APIs for data and storage operations.
body.body: Provide Supabase project URL and API key or service role credentials to query PostgREST endpoints, manage storage buckets/files, and use auth-enabled requests, returning JSON responses for workflows.

body.name: terraform
body.title: Terraform
body.description: Tasks that run Terraform commands from Kestra.
body.body: Provide Terraform configuration paths, backend/env variables, and CLI arguments to init, plan, apply, or destroy infrastructure, capturing outputs and state paths for deployment pipelines.

body.name: cli
body.title: Terraform CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute Terraform CLI operations.
body.body: Set working directory, env vars, backend config, and command arguments to run Terraform init/plan/apply/destroy from Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and plan outputs.

body.name: tickets
body.title: Zendesk Tickets
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and retrieve Zendesk tickets.
body.body: Set the Zendesk instance URL with email/API token, ticket fields, and requester info to file or update tickets, add comments, or fetch ticket details for support automation.

body.name: zendesk
body.title: Zendesk
body.description: Tasks that interact with the Zendesk API for ticketing.
body.body: Provide Zendesk subdomain, email/token credentials, and resource IDs to create, update, list, or delete tickets and related objects, returning API responses for support workflows.

body.name: typesense
body.title: Typesense
body.description: Tasks that load data into and query Typesense collections.
body.body: Provide Typesense API host/key and collection schema to create/update collections, import documents, and run searches with filters and sorting, returning JSON results for downstream workflows.

body.name: timefold
body.title: Timefold
body.description: Timefold plugin for Kestra

body.name: todoist
body.title: Todoist
body.description: Tasks that manage Todoist tasks through the Todoist API.
body.body: Use your Todoist API token to create, update, complete, delete, or list tasks with fields like content, due dates, labels, and project IDs, returning task payloads and URLs for further workflow steps.

body.name: squadcast
body.title: Squadcast
body.description: Tasks that create incidents in Squadcast.
body.body: Use the Squadcast event endpoint and routing key plus incident details (message, severity, source) to raise alerts from Kestra workflows and capture the response.

body.name: xquik
body.title: Xquik
body.description: Xquik X/Twitter public data plugin for Kestra
body.body:
Xquik tasks let Kestra flows retrieve public X/Twitter data for scheduled research, monitoring, and reporting workflows.

The plugin includes read-only tasks for:
- Searching public posts.
- Fetching one public post by ID.
- Searching public users.
- Fetching one public user by username or ID.
- Fetching recent public posts from a user.
- Listing regional trends.

Use `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}` for the `apiKey` property. Search and list tasks support `fetchType` so larger responses can be stored in Kestra internal storage.

body.name: users
body.title: Xquik Users
body.description: Tasks that search users and retrieve public X/Twitter profile data with Xquik.
body.body: Use these tasks to search users, fetch one user by username or ID, and retrieve recent public posts from a user. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

body.name: grok
body.title: Grok
body.description: Tasks that parse text using Grok patterns.
body.body: Provide input strings or files with Grok patterns and optional custom pattern definitions to extract structured fields from logs or messages, emitting parsed records for downstream processing.

body.name: jsonata
body.title: JSONata
body.description: Tasks that transform JSON using JSONata expressions.
body.body: Provide input JSON and a JSONata expression to reshape or filter data, with optional variables and environment settings; outputs the transformed JSON for subsequent tasks.

body.name: snmp
body.title: SNMP
body.description: Tasks that send SNMP traps or informs for network monitoring.
body.body: Specify the SNMP version, target host/port, community or security params, and payload OIDs to emit traps or informs to your NMS, enabling Kestra flows to notify external monitoring systems.

body.name: transform
body.title: Transform
body.description: Transform typed records, variables, and Ion data.
body.body: Provide records, variables, or Ion files to filter, map, select, aggregate, unnest, or zip structured data with typed expressions, outputting transformed records or Ion data for downstream tasks.

body.name: sentry
body.title: Sentry
body.description: Tasks that send events to Sentry.
body.body: Provide the Sentry DSN and event payload (message, level, tags, extras) to capture errors or alerts in Sentry from Kestra flows.

body.name: zulip
body.title: Zulip
body.description: Tasks that send messages to Zulip streams or users.
body.body: Provide Zulip server URL, email/API key, stream/topic or user targets, and message content to post notifications from Kestra workflows.

body.name: tweets
body.title: Xquik Tweets
body.description: Tasks that search and retrieve public X/Twitter posts with Xquik.
body.body: Use these tasks to search public posts, fetch one post by ID, and store larger responses in Kestra internal storage. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

body.name: trello
body.title: Atlassian Trello
body.description: Integration plugin for Atlassian Trello to manage boards, lists, cards, and workflow automation.
body.body: Trello is a visual collaboration platform that organizes projects into boards. This plugin provides comprehensive integration with Trello's REST API, enabling you to automate board management, list operations, and card workflows. Use it to streamline project tracking, synchronize data between Trello and other systems, and build event-driven automation based on Trello activities.

body.name: cards
body.title: Trello Cards
body.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Trello cards - create, update, move, comment, and monitor card changes.
body.body: The Cards subpackage provides comprehensive functionality for working with Trello cards. It includes tasks to create new cards, update existing ones, move cards between lists or boards, add comments, and a polling trigger to monitor card creation and updates. These capabilities enable automated card management and event-driven workflows based on Trello card activities.

body.name: trends
body.title: Xquik Trends
body.description: Tasks that retrieve public X/Twitter trends with Xquik.
body.body: Use these tasks to list regional or worldwide X/Twitter trends for scheduled research and monitoring flows. Set `apiKey` with `{{ secret('XQUIK_API_KEY') }}`.

body.name: workflow
body.title: Temporal Workflow
body.description: Tasks that trigger, signal, query, wait for, and schedule Temporal workflows.

body.name: temporal
body.title: Temporal
body.description: Kestra tasks for interacting with Temporal workflow orchestration: trigger, signal, query, wait, and schedule workflows.

body.name: yaml
body.title: YAML
body.description: Tasks that convert between YAML and ION/JSON.
body.body: Provide YAML content to convert to ION or JSON, or take ION/JSON and emit YAML, making it easy to translate configs inside workflows.

body.name: excel
body.title: Excel
body.description: Tasks that convert between Excel and ION.
body.body: Supply Excel workbooks to convert sheets into ION data, or take ION data to generate Excel files with configurable column rendering and date/time handling.

body.name: json
body.title: JSON
body.description: Tasks that convert JSON and JSONL to/from ION.
body.body: Provide JSON or JSONL inputs to convert into ION or other formats, or take ION to emit JSON/JSONL, with options for pretty-printing and schema validation.

body.name: csv
body.title: CSV
body.description: Tasks that convert between CSV and ION.
body.body: Provide CSV input with delimiter/quote/header options to convert to ION, or supply ION data to emit CSV, handling bad lines and encoding settings as needed.

body.name: markdown
body.title: Markdown
body.description: Tasks that convert Markdown to text or HTML.
body.body: Provide Markdown content to render as plain text or HTML using the built-in converters, useful for generating notifications or documents from workflows.

body.name: serdes
body.title: Serialization
body.description: Tasks that convert data (SerDes) between common formats for Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use format-specific tasks to transform files among JSON, CSV, Avro, Parquet, Excel, Protobuf, XML, Markdown, and YAML (via ION), with options for schema validation, bad-line handling, and output destinations.

body.name: xml
body.title: XML
body.description: Tasks that convert between XML and ION.
body.body: Provide XML input with optional namespaces to convert to ION or supply ION data to produce XML, enabling XML interchange within workflows.

body.name: parquet
body.title: Parquet
body.description: Tasks that convert between Parquet and ION.
body.body: Provide Parquet files and optional schemas to convert to ION, or supply ION data to write Parquet with compression and schema controls for analytics pipelines.

body.name: avro
body.title: Avro
body.description: Tasks that convert to/from Apache Avro and validate schemas.
body.body: Provide Avro schemas and input files (Avro, ION, or JSON) to convert between Avro and ION, infer schemas, and validate data, outputting files or validation results for pipelines.

body.name: iam
body.title: Huawei IAM
body.description: Huawei Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) authentication tasks.

body.name: seaweedfs
body.title: SeaweedFS
body.description: SeaweedFS internal storage plugin for Kestra

body.name: nutanix
body.title: Nutanix (EE)
body.description: Tasks that automate Nutanix operations within Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use this plugin to orchestrate AHV VM lifecycle, snapshotting, and template management from a single flow. Configure each task with your endpoint and credentials so runs can safely manage infrastructure as part of data or CI/CD pipelines.

body.name: dataset
body.title: Apify Dataset
body.description: Tasks that retrieve Apify dataset items or export them to storage with filtering.
body.body: Use `datasetId` with your `apiToken` to poll for dataset availability, filter or flatten fields, control sorting and pagination, and skip empty or hidden items. The Save task can output JSON, CSV, and other formats to temp storage with delimiter/BOM controls, while Get returns the ready-to-use item list after retrying until data is available.

body.name: snapshot
body.title: Nutanix Snapshots
body.description: Tasks that manage AHV VM snapshots in Nutanix.
body.body: Create, list, restore, and delete AHV VM snapshots (recovery points) using Prism Central dataprotection APIs.

body.name: ahv
body.title: Nutanix AHV
body.description: Tasks that manage AHV VM lifecycle in Nutanix.
body.body: Use these tasks to create, update, power, and convert AHV VMs via Prism Central.

body.name: datadog
body.title: Datadog (EE)
body.description: Tasks that ship Kestra workflow logs to Datadog via the HTTP intake API for centralized monitoring.
body.body: Use the LogExporter with a Datadog basePath and apiKey to push run logs to the correct regional endpoint. Configure source, service, and chunk size to match your Datadog log attribution and throughput needs, and pair it with a LogShipper to automate log exports.

body.name: meta
body.title: Meta
body.description: Tasks that automate Meta (Facebook and Instagram) publishing with the Graph API.
body.body: Provide a Meta access token and the relevant Page or Instagram Business IDs to create, schedule, list, or delete posts and media while retrieving insights for reporting across Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts.

body.name: protobuf
body.title: Protobuf
body.description: Tasks that convert Protocol Buffers messages to/from ION.
body.body: Provide Protobuf descriptors and message data to convert to ION for inspection or downstream transforms, or serialize ION back to Protobuf binaries for interchange.

body.name: actor
body.title: Apify Actor
body.description: Tasks that run Apify Actors with configurable inputs, limits, and webhooks.
body.body: Provide `actorId` and `apiToken` to start an Apify Actor from a workflow and receive the resulting run payload. Optional parameters like `input`, `maxItems`, `maxTotalChargeUsd`, `build`, and `waitForFinish` let you cap spend, pick builds, and wait for completion while staying notified via webhooks.

body.name: task
body.title: Apify Task
body.description: Tasks that run a saved Apify Task and return its run payload.
body.body: Provide `taskId` and `apiToken` to start a saved Apify Task from a workflow. Optional input overrides and a synchronous wait let you tune each run and block until it finishes while receiving the resulting run payload.

body.name: apify
body.title: Apify
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate Apify Actors and datasets from Kestra.
body.body: Trigger Apify Actors and collect their datasets without hand-rolling API calls. All tasks require an Apify API token via `apiToken`, and expose controls for actor inputs, cost/time limits, and dataset retrieval or export options.

body.name: dis
body.title: Huawei DIS
body.description: Tasks and triggers for Huawei Cloud DIS (Data Ingestion Service): write and consume records on a data stream, the Huawei equivalent of AWS Kinesis Data Streams.

body.name: ces
body.title: Huawei CES
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud CES: push custom metrics, query metric statistics, and trigger flows on metric datapoints.

body.name: dli
body.title: Huawei DLI
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud DLI (Data Lake Insight): run SQL queries against data in OBS or federated sources.

body.name: posts
body.title: Facebook
body.description: Tasks that create, schedule, list, and manage Facebook Page posts.
body.body: Provide the Page ID and long-lived access token to publish or delete posts, fetch existing content with insights, or schedule posts for later, using options such as `scheduledPublishTime`, `attachedMedia`, and `pageId` to control delivery.

body.name: whatsapp
body.title: WhatsApp
body.description: Tasks that send WhatsApp messages (via Twilio API).
body.body: Use Twilio WhatsApp credentials with from/to numbers and message content to push WhatsApp notifications from Kestra workflows.

body.name: adanos
body.title: Adanos
body.description: Stock and crypto market sentiment data from Reddit, X / FinTwit, financial news, and Polymarket
body.body:
Adanos tasks add read-only market sentiment and attention data to Kestra workflows.

The plugin can retrieve one asset, list trending assets, compare assets, and return aggregate market sentiment. Stock data is available from Reddit, X / FinTwit, financial news, and Polymarket; crypto data currently uses Reddit.

Use `{{ secret('ADANOS_API_KEY') }}` for the `apiKey` property. Every task supports Kestra fetch and internal-storage result handling.

body.name: media
body.title: Instagram
body.description: Tasks that publish and inspect media for Instagram Business accounts.
body.body: Use an Instagram Business access token and user ID to upload images, carousels, or videos, list existing media, and pull engagement insights, ensuring required fields like `caption`, `mediaUrls`, and `igUserId` are set before posting.

body.name: messenger
body.title: Messenger
body.description: Tasks that send notifications via Facebook Messenger.
body.body: Provide the Facebook Page access token and recipient ID to send text or template messages from workflows into Messenger conversations.

body.name: obs
body.title: Huawei OBS
body.description: Object- and bucket-level tasks for Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS): upload, download, list, copy, delete, batch-delete, create and delete buckets, and trigger flows on new objects.

body.name: koocli
body.title: Huawei KooCLI
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud KooCLI (hcloud): run arbitrary hcloud commands in a container with automatic IAM credential injection.

body.name: rfs
body.title: Huawei RFS
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud RFS (Resource Formation Service): create, update, and delete Terraform/HCL-based resource stacks.

body.name: dms-kafka
body.title: Huawei DMS for Kafka
body.description: Produce, consume, trigger, and react to messages on Huawei Cloud DMS for Kafka

body.name: mrs
body.title: Huawei MRS
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud MRS (MapReduce Service): create clusters, submit job steps, and delete clusters.

body.name: swr
body.title: Huawei SWR
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud SWR: obtain short-lived Docker/OCI registry auth tokens.

body.name: smn
body.title: Huawei SMN
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud SMN: publish notification messages to a topic.

body.name: huawei
body.title: Huawei
body.description: Huawei plugin for Kestra

body.name: aikido
body.title: Aikido
body.description: Aikido Security plugin for Kestra
body.body: Scan repositories, containers, and domains for vulnerabilities; triage and export security issues; retrieve compliance reports; and react to new critical findings in real time with the Aikido Security public API.

body.name: aikido-issues
body.title: Aikido Issues
body.description: Tasks and a trigger for listing, fetching, exporting, and snoozing Aikido security issues.
