body.body: List and fetch open issue groups, export issues to CSV/JSON, snooze or unsnooze issues, and trigger a flow on newly detected issues above a severity threshold.

body.name: geminidb
body.title: Huawei GeminiDB
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud GeminiDB for NoSQL: put, get, delete, query, and scan items via its DynamoDB-Compatible API.

body.name: aikido-clouds
body.title: Aikido Clouds
body.description: Tasks for listing Aikido's connected cloud environments and their discovered cloud assets.
body.body: List connected cloud environments and discovered cloud assets, with filtering and STORE support for large inventories.

body.name: dataarts
body.title: Huawei DataArts Studio
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud DataArts Studio (DataArts Factory / DLF): start, monitor, and stop batch job runs.

body.name: aikido-domains
body.title: Aikido Domains
body.description: Tasks for listing and scanning domains connected to Aikido's surface/DAST monitoring.
body.body: List monitored domains and trigger a DAST scan on a connected domain with optional wait-for-completion.

body.name: dms-rocketmq
body.title: Huawei DMS for RocketMQ
body.description: Publish, consume, trigger, and react to messages on Huawei Cloud DMS for RocketMQ

body.name: functiongraph
body.title: Huawei FunctionGraph
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph: synchronously invoke serverless functions and capture their responses.

body.name: eventgrid
body.title: Huawei EventGrid
body.description: Tasks for Huawei Cloud EventGrid: publish CloudEvents-formatted events to a custom channel.

body.name: gke
body.title: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
body.description: Deploy and manage containerized applications on GKE. Orchestrate Kubernetes workloads alongside your data pipelines.

body.name: aikido-repositories
body.title: Aikido Repositories
body.description: Tasks for listing, scanning, and exporting the SBOM of Aikido code repositories.
body.body: List connected code repositories, trigger SAST/IaC/secrets scans with optional wait-for-completion, and export a repository's SBOM or license report.

body.name: gcs
body.title: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
body.description: Store, manage, and access files in Google Cloud Storage. Move data reliably between systems with simple file operations.

body.name: aikido-containers
body.title: Aikido Containers
body.description: Tasks for listing, scanning, and exporting the SBOM of Aikido container repositories.
body.body: List connected container repositories, trigger a rescan with optional wait-for-completion, and export a container's SBOM or license report.

body.name: cli
body.title: Google Cloud CLI
body.description: Execute any Google Cloud CLI command directly from your workflows. Automate GCP operations using the full power of the gcloud CLI.

body.name: aikido-compliance
body.title: Aikido Compliance
body.description: Tasks for retrieving Aikido compliance framework overviews.
body.body: Fetch the rule-by-rule compliance overview for ISO 27001, NIS2, or SOC 2.

body.name: spanner
body.title: Google Cloud Spanner
body.description: Tasks to query, execute DML/DDL statements, and manage databases in Google Cloud Spanner, the globally distributed, horizontally scalable database service.
body.body: Use these tasks to execute SELECT queries, run DML/DDL updates, run batch DML operations, create or delete databases, and trigger flows on database changes in Google Cloud Spanner. Authentication follows the same GCP service account pattern as the other plugin-gcp sub-plugins (CredentialService).

body.name: bigquery
body.title: Google Cloud BigQuery
body.description: Build high-performance data pipelines with BigQuery. Query, transform, and load data at scale without infrastructure management.

body.name: bigtable
body.title: Google Cloud Bigtable
body.description: Tasks to read, write, and delete rows in Google Cloud Bigtable, the fully managed, petabyte-scale NoSQL database optimised for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
body.body: Use these tasks to read, write, and delete rows or tables in Google Cloud Bigtable, and to trigger flows when new rows are detected. Authentication follows the same GCP service account pattern as the other plugin-gcp sub-plugins (CredentialService). Use ReadRows with the STORE fetch type for large result sets to avoid loading the full result set into memory.

body.name: auth
body.title: Google Cloud Auth
body.description: Fetch Google Cloud OAuth access tokens for use by downstream tasks or external systems.

body.name: batches
body.title: Google Cloud Dataproc Batches
body.description: Run Spark and Hadoop jobs on-demand without managing clusters. Process large-scale data with Dataproc Batches.

body.name: compute
body.title: Google Compute Engine
body.description: Create, start, stop, and delete Compute Engine virtual machine instances as part of orchestrated workflows.
body.body: Use these tasks to create, start, stop, and delete Compute Engine virtual machine instances as part of a flow. Each task waits for the operation to complete within a configurable timeout and returns the instance name, ID, status, and IP addresses.

body.name: pubsub
body.title: Google Cloud Pub/Sub
body.description: Process real-time data streams with Google Cloud Pub/Sub. Build event-driven workflows that respond instantly to your data.

body.name: rcs
body.title: Google Cloud RCS
body.description: Send Rich Communication Services (RCS) messages using Google RCS Business Messaging (RBM).
body.body: Use these tasks to send plain text, rich cards, carousels, and file attachments directly to recipient phone numbers. Authentication is integrated with GCP service accounts (CredentialService).

body.name: gcp
body.title: Google Cloud
body.description: Execute tasks and orchestrate workflows across Google Cloud Platform services. Centralize authentication and resource management for seamless GCP integration.

body.name: dataflow
body.title: Google Cloud Dataflow
body.description: Tasks to launch, monitor, and cancel Google Cloud Dataflow Classic and Flex template jobs.
body.body: Use these tasks to execute templates, launch jobs, monitor pipelines, cancel executions, and trigger flows when Dataflow pipelines reach completion. Authentication is integrated with GCP service accounts (CredentialService).

body.name: dataform
body.title: Google Cloud DataForm
body.description: Automate data transformation workflows with DataForm. Execute SQL-based ELT pipelines with built-in lineage and testing.

body.name: function
body.title: Google Cloud Function
body.description: Trigger serverless functions and orchestrate event-driven computing. Execute code without provisioning or managing servers.

body.name: vertexai
body.title: Google Cloud Vertex AI
body.description: Integrate machine learning models into your workflows. Train, deploy, and invoke ML models with Vertex AI.

body.name: dags
body.title: Airflow DAGs
body.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Apache Airflow DAG runs.
body.body: Trigger DAG executions through Airflow's REST API with required baseUrl and dagId, optionally pass a custom body payload for conf, and authenticate via headers or HTTP options such as basic auth or bearer tokens. Enable wait with pollFrequency and maxDuration to track completion and return run details including dagRunId, state, started, and ended timestamps.

body.name: airflow
body.title: Airflow
body.description: Tasks that let Kestra workflows interact with Apache Airflow.
body.body: Use these plugins to call into existing Airflow deployments from Kestra, bridging workflows without migrating DAGs. Configure the Airflow REST API baseUrl, provide auth via custom headers or HTTP options, and reuse Airflow DAGs while coordinating upstream and downstream steps.

body.name: clusters
body.title: Google Cloud Dataproc Clusters
body.description: Create and manage Dataproc clusters for distributed data processing. Orchestrate complex analytics workloads at scale.

body.name: git
body.title: Git
body.description: Tasks that clone, fetch, and interact with Git repositories.
body.body: Provide a repository URL with branch/tag/ref, optional credentials or SSH keys, and working directory settings to clone or update repositories, handle submodules, and make source available to downstream tasks.

body.name: monitoring
body.title: Google Cloud Monitoring (Observability)
body.description: Integrate Google Cloud Monitoring metrics and logs into your workflows. Build monitoring and alerting directly into your orchestration.

body.name: tool
body.title: Tool
body.description: Tasks that expose tools agents can call: Kestra flow/task runners, sub-agent and A2A delegation, skills, code execution, MCP clients, and web search to extend LLM reasoning with actions and real-time data.

body.name: agent
body.title: Agent
body.description: Tasks that run AI agents combining system prompts, user input, tools, content retrievers, and optional memory to produce grounded responses, including proxying prompts to remote agents over the A2A protocol.

body.name: ai
body.title: AI
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate generative AI in Kestra with LangChain4j, covering chat completions, agents, RAG, tools, and shared providers.

body.name: completion
body.title: Completion
body.description: Tasks that call LLMs for chat, classification, image generation, and JSON-structured extraction, with optional tools, memory, and provider flexibility.
body.body:
For OpenAI-compatible and Mistral chat providers, model requests inherit the task-level `timeout`.
If no task timeout is configured, the chat model timeout defaults to `PT120S` (120 seconds).

body.name: mcp
body.title: MCP
body.description: Tasks that call a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server directly — list its tools or invoke one and return the result — without going through an LLM.

body.name: retriever
body.title: Retriever
body.description: Tasks that pull external context for Retrieval Augmented Generation: embedding-store retrieval, web search via Google or Tavily, and SQL database retrieval, feeding results into AI prompts.

body.name: rag
body.title: RAG
body.description: Tasks that ingest, chunk, and embed documents, search vectors, and run retrieval-augmented chat so LLM answers stay grounded in indexed content.

body.name: memory
body.title: Memory
body.description: Tasks that supply conversational memory backends (Kestra KV Store, Redis, PostgreSQL) to persist recent messages for agents and chat completions.

body.name: provider
body.title: Provider
body.description: Tasks that configure Large Language Model providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, Bedrock, etc.) to supply chat/completion models used across the AI plugins.

body.name: firestore
body.title: Google Cloud Firestore
body.description: Access and manage Firestore databases directly from your workflows. Store and retrieve structured data with serverless simplicity.

body.name: camunda
body.title: Camunda
body.description: Interact with a Camunda 8 cluster from Kestra flows.
body.body:
Camunda 8 is a process orchestrator built around BPMN. This plugin talks to a Camunda 8 cluster
with the official `camunda-client-java` client, so Kestra flows can drive Camunda process
instances and Camunda service tasks can be implemented as Kestra flows.

It covers deploying BPMN, DMN and form resources, starting and cancelling process instances,
publishing correlation messages, holding a job worker open as a realtime trigger, and completing
the activated job from the flow.

Authentication supports no credentials (development clusters), Basic auth, OAuth2 against a
self-managed identity provider, and Camunda SaaS client credentials.

body.name: logs
body.title: Clever Cloud Logs
body.description: Tasks and triggers for fetching, streaming, and forwarding Clever Cloud application logs.

body.name: cli
body.title: Ansible CLI
body.description: Tasks that run Ansible CLI commands to execute playbooks and capture results.
body.body: Provide commands (required) and any playbooks or inventories via inputFiles or Namespace Files; tasks run in a container image (default cytopia/ansible:latest-tools) with optional beforeCommands and env to prepare the environment. A default ansible.cfg and callback plugin are injected so playbook outputs, per-task details, and logs (when outputLogFile is true) are returned to Kestra.

body.name: embeddings
body.title: Embeddings
body.description: Tasks that provision embeddings stores (Chroma, PGVector, Pinecone, Redis, Qdrant, etc.) for chunk storage and similarity search powering RAG flows.

body.name: ansible
body.title: Ansible
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate Ansible playbooks from Kestra flows.
body.body: Use this plugin set when you need to run Ansible automation inside Kestra with containerized runners; it supports Namespace Files or inline playbooks, injects a default ansible.cfg with the Kestra callback for structured outputs, and can expose execution logs on demand.

body.name: amqp
body.title: AMQP
body.description: Tasks that connect to RabbitMQ brokers to declare exchanges and queues, bind routing keys, publish messages, and consume them via tasks or triggers (batch or real time).
body.body: Provide host/port/credentials/virtual host values for each connection, and set stop conditions such as maxDuration or maxRecords when consuming.

body.name: algolia
body.title: Algolia
body.description: Tasks that integrate with Algolia Search to index, query, and delete records.
body.body: They use your Algolia Application ID and Admin API Key to operate on a target index, supporting batch writes, replacements, and removals. Use them to populate indexes (Index), clean up by objectID (Delete), or retrieve hits with any Algolia search parameters (Search).

body.name: anthropic
body.title: Anthropic
body.description: Tasks that call Anthropic Claude models for chat completions and manage the Files API.
body.body: Configure an Anthropic API key, pick the Claude model to run, tune generation controls like temperature and max tokens, upload and manage files, and capture token usage metrics for your executions.

body.name: astradb
body.title: Astra DB
body.description: Tasks that run CQL queries and triggers on DataStax Astra DB.
body.body: Connect with either a base64-encoded secure connect bundle or a proxy address (use only one), plus keyspace, clientId, and clientSecret to build the Astra session for query and trigger tasks. Ideal for serverless Cassandra workloads that need polling or data retrieval within Kestra while keeping authentication and connectivity consistent.

body.name: addons
body.title: Clever Cloud Add-ons
body.description: Tasks and a trigger for managing Clever Cloud add-ons: databases, caches, and other managed services.

body.name: applications
body.title: Clever Cloud Applications
body.description: Tasks for managing Clever Cloud applications: create, configure, scale, deploy, and delete.
body.body: Manage the lifecycle of Clever Cloud applications from Kestra: list, inspect, create, set environment variables, scale, redeploy, restart, stop, and delete. Authenticates with a single API token, and targets the personal account via /self when organisationId is omitted.

body.name: organisations
body.title: Clever Cloud Organisations
body.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Clever Cloud organisations and their members.

body.name: deployments
body.title: Clever Cloud Deployments
body.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Clever Cloud application deployments.

body.name: clevercloud
body.title: Clever Cloud
body.description: Clever Cloud plugin for Kestra

body.name: standard
body.title: Apache Cassandra
body.description: Tasks that run CQL queries or polling triggers against self-managed Apache Cassandra clusters.
body.body: Use these tasks to execute queries or fire triggers with a Cassandra session built from contact endpoints, optional local datacenter, credentials, and SSL truststore/keystore details. Use `fetchType` (FETCH, FETCH_ONE, STORE, or NONE) so downstream steps can consume result rows while reusing the same connection schema across query and trigger tasks.

body.name: cassandra
body.title: Apache Cassandra
body.description: Tasks that integrate Apache Cassandra into Kestra workflows for querying and event-driven triggers.
body.body: Provides CQL-based query and trigger tasks for both self-managed Cassandra clusters and Astra DB, allowing flows to fetch data or react when rows appear. Each subgroup requires its own session configuration (endpoints with auth and SSL, or Astra secure bundle/proxy with credentials and keyspace) to establish connections.

body.name: cobol
body.title: IBM i / AS400 COBOL
body.description: Tasks that run, submit and create IBM i COBOL programs and jobs
body.body: Call IBM i (AS/400) COBOL programs synchronously with `CallJob`, submit them as asynchronous batch jobs with `SubmitJob`, and compile COBOL source into program objects with `CreateProgram`, all over the JTOpen library and authenticated with a host, user profile, and password.

body.name: beam
body.title: Apache Beam
body.description: Tasks that run pipelines against SDKs and dedicated runners including Apache Flink
body.body: Execute Apache Beam pipelines defined in YAML on Direct, Flink, Spark, or Dataflow runners while forwarding Beam metrics to Kestra.

body.name: cloudquery
body.title: CloudQuery
body.description: Tasks that run CloudQuery commands to sync data through the CLI.
body.body: Use these tasks to execute CloudQuery syncs from inline YAML or config files, optionally persisting incremental state in Kestra's KV Store for reliable resumes. CloudQueryCLI runs arbitrary commands with configurable env, container image, and input/output files.

body.name: openpgp
body.title: OpenPGP
body.description: Tasks that encrypt and decrypt files with OpenPGP, including optional signing and signature verification.
body.body: Encrypt accepts a source file (`from`), recipient list, and ASCII-armored public keys, and can sign the output when given signing keys and a passphrase; Decrypt takes the encrypted file, a private key with optional passphrase, and can validate signatures against allowed users. Both tasks stream files through Kestra storage and return the resulting file URI for downstream processing.

body.name: crypto
body.title: Cryptography
body.description: Tasks that secure files in Kestra pipelines using OpenPGP encryption, decryption, and signature validation.
body.body: Use this plugin when you need to protect files end-to-end with OpenPGP: provide internal storage URIs as inputs, public keys and recipient lists for encryption, and private keys with optional signer keys for decryption and verification. Tasks write the processed file back to Kestra storage and return its URI for downstream steps.

body.name: pages
body.title: Confluence Pages
body.description: Tasks that create, list, and update Confluence pages with Markdown rendering and metadata controls.
body.body: Use these tasks to publish or sync documentation while keeping Confluence as the source of truth; they convert Markdown to the storage format and return results as JSON, Markdown, or stored files. Each call needs Confluence credentials (`serverUrl`, `username`, `apiToken`); create/update expect page details and Markdown content (update also requires `pageId`, `status`, `title`, and `versionInfo`), and list supports filters for spaces, page IDs, titles, status, subtype, sorting, and pagination.

body.name: confluence
body.title: Atlassian Confluence
body.description: Tasks that connect Kestra flows to Atlassian Confluence for creating, updating, and retrieving page content.
body.body: Use this plugin to integrate Kestra flows with Confluence via the REST API. Provide `serverUrl`, `username`, and `apiToken` for authentication; page tasks render Markdown to Confluence storage and return JSON or Markdown for downstream steps.

body.name: ceph
body.title: Ceph
body.description: Manage Ceph clusters through the Ceph Dashboard REST API: cluster health, pools, RBD images and snapshots, and the Object Gateway (RGW).
body.body: Authenticate against the Ceph Dashboard, monitor cluster health (including a trigger for degraded state), and manage storage pools, RBD block images and snapshots, and RGW buckets and users.

body.name: pools
body.title: Ceph Pools
body.description: Tasks that manage Ceph storage pools.
body.body: List, get, create, update, and delete Ceph storage pools, including replication and placement group settings.

body.name: images
body.title: Ceph RBD Images
body.description: Tasks that manage RBD block images.
body.body: List, create, and delete RBD block images within a Ceph pool.

body.name: rgw
body.title: Ceph Object Gateway (RGW)
body.description: Tasks that manage RGW buckets and users.
body.body: List and create Object Gateway buckets and users, and delete buckets.

body.name: dagger
body.title: Dagger
body.description: Tasks that run Dagger pipelines, commands, and scripts from Kestra.
body.body: Run Dagger CLI pipelines from Kestra using `Commands` for one or more inline pipeline expressions or `Script` for an inline multi-step script. Both run through a script task runner (Process or Docker) and auto-install a pinned, checksum-verified Dagger CLI when it is not already available.

body.name: cluster
body.title: Ceph Cluster Health
body.description: Tasks and triggers that report on overall Ceph cluster health.
body.body: Fetch the full or minimal Ceph health report, and trigger a flow the moment the cluster transitions into a degraded (HEALTH_WARN or HEALTH_ERR) state.

body.name: snapshots
body.title: Ceph RBD Snapshots
body.description: Tasks that manage RBD image snapshots.
body.body: Create, list, delete, roll back, and clone snapshots of RBD block images.

body.name: cli
body.title: Databricks CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute Databricks CLI and SQL CLI commands through containerized tools.
body.body: Run administrative actions or quick queries with the Databricks CLI by supplying the workspace host, personal access token, and the CLI commands to execute, or target the SQL warehouse via the SQL CLI with host, token, HTTP path, and SQL statements. Ideal for scripting one-off operations, validating configurations, or orchestrating CLI-based workflows without managing the binaries yourself.

body.name: job
body.title: Databricks Job
body.description: Tasks that configure and run Databricks jobs with one or more tasks.
body.body: Create a job or submit an ad-hoc run on Databricks using your workspace host and token, defining task blocks (notebook, dbt, Spark submit/JAR/Python, SQL, pipeline, or run-job) that target an existing cluster. Set `taskKey` and `dependsOn` when chaining multiple tasks, and optionally block until completion with `waitForCompletion` to align with downstream steps.

body.name: sql
body.title: Databricks SQL
body.description: Tasks that execute SQL queries on a Databricks cluster via JDBC.
body.body: Run parameterized SQL against a Databricks cluster or SQL warehouse using the JDBC driver by providing the host, HTTP path, access token, and SQL statement. Results are streamed to Kestra storage (Ion format) with a row-count metric, and you can supply optional catalog/schema, time zone, and JDBC properties.

body.name: dbfs
body.title: DBFS
body.description: Tasks that move files between Kestra and the Databricks File System (DBFS).
body.body: Use these tasks to upload or download artifacts for your pipelines through DBFS using your Databricks host and token. Specify the source file from Kestra storage via `from` and the DBFS destination via `to`; downloads return a Kestra storage URI so the file can be reused downstream.

body.name: compress
body.title: Compression
body.description: Tasks that compress and decompress files and archives for Kestra flows.
body.body: Use ArchiveCompress, ArchiveDecompress, FileCompress, and FileDecompress to package or extract files stored in Kestra, providing the `from` internal storage URI plus an `algorithm` for archives and a `compression` format for both archive and single-file operations. Use FileEncrypt and FileDecrypt to encrypt and decrypt files: the default mode (PBKDF2_SHA256) uses AES-256-CBC and is compatible with `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2`; the PBKDF2_SHA512, ARGON2ID, and SCRYPT modes use AES-256-GCM with a self-describing KESTRAENC file format that embeds all derivation parameters so FileDecrypt needs only the password. Outputs return new storage URIs (archives also expose an entry map and size/count metrics), making it easy to pass compressed or encrypted artifacts to uploads or downstream tasks.

body.name: cli
body.title: Dataform CLI
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate Dataform through CLI commands.
body.body: Run the Dataform CLI in Kestra to compile, validate, or execute projects using the required `commands` list; add optional `beforeCommands` for setup, supply credentials or configs via `env` and `inputFiles`, and override the container image or task runner when needed.

body.name: dagster
body.title: Dagster
body.description: Tasks that trigger Dagster jobs via the GraphQL API and optionally wait for results so Kestra flows can orchestrate runs.
body.body: Launch Dagster jobs from Kestra while passing run configuration and tags. Requires baseUrl, location, repository, and jobName; provide headers for authentication and tune wait, maxDuration, and pollFrequency when monitoring until completion.

body.name: cluster
body.title: Databricks Cluster
body.description: Tasks that create and delete Databricks clusters.
body.body: Use these tasks to provision or retire Databricks compute directly from a flow with your workspace host and token. Provide the cluster name, Spark version, and either a fixed worker count (`numWorkers`) or autoscaling bounds (`minWorkers`/`maxWorkers`), optionally with an auto-termination timeout.

body.name: couchbase
body.title: Couchbase
body.description: Tasks that execute Couchbase N1QL queries and trigger Kestra flows from query results.
body.body: Run Couchbase operations from Kestra with the Query task for on-demand N1QL execution and the Trigger to poll queries on a schedule. Supply the database connection string, username, password, and query; optional parameters and fetchType control whether rows are returned, a single row is provided, or results are stored for downstream tasks.

body.name: dataform
body.title: Dataform
body.description: Tasks that run Dataform data transformations through the Dataform CLI.
body.body: Run the Dataform CLI in Kestra to compile, validate, and execute Dataform projects against your data warehouse. Provide the CLI `commands` to run and optional `beforeCommands` for setup, and pass credentials and project configuration via `env` and `inputFiles`; the task runs in a container (default `dataformco/dataform:latest`) or any configured task runner.

body.name: databricks
body.title: Databricks
body.description: Databricks plugin for Kestra

body.name: deepseek
body.title: DeepSeek
body.description: Tasks that call DeepSeek chat models for conversational or schema-guided JSON responses.
body.body: Use DeepSeek ChatCompletion to orchestrate role-based conversations or JSON-only replies within Kestra Flows. Requires `apiKey`, `modelName`, and `messages`; defaults `baseUrl` to `https://api.deepseek.com/v1` for OpenAI-compatible routing. Add `jsonResponseSchema` to enable JSON Mode with a prepended schema reminder; DeepSeek treats the schema as guidance rather than server-side validation.

body.name: documentdb
body.title: DocumentDB
body.description: Tasks that manage DocumentDB collections with MongoDB-compatible insert, query, update, and delete operations.
body.body: Connect to DocumentDB's HTTP API to insert, read, update, and delete collection data. Provide `host`, `database`, `collection`, `username`, and `password`; Insert handles one document or up to 10 via `documents`, Read supports filters or aggregation pipelines with `fetchType` output handling, and Update/Delete apply MongoDB-style filters with `updateMany`/`deleteMany` switches to control scope.

body.name: discord
body.title: Discord
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Discord via webhooks.
body.body: Provide the Discord webhook URL and message content (optionally embeds/username/avatar) to post alerts from workflows into Discord channels.

body.name: dlt
body.title: dlt
body.description: Tasks that run dlt (data load tool) pipelines and CLI commands to move data into analytics destinations.
body.body: Use these tasks to execute dlt workloads either from inline Python (`Run`) or through non-interactive CLI commands (`CLI`). Provide a Python `script` or list of `commands`, set `beforeCommands` to install dependencies, and adjust the default `ghcr.io/kestra-io/dlt` image when you need custom environments; the CLI task also auto-adds `--non-interactive` and installs `requirements.txt` after `dlt init`.

body.name: files
body.title: Dropbox Files
body.description: Tasks that manage files and folders in Dropbox.
body.body: Use these tasks to upload from Kestra storage, download back to it, list or search folders, and create, copy, move, or delete items while retrieving metadata when needed. All tasks require a Dropbox accessToken secret; Dropbox paths must begin with '/', and file-oriented steps accept Kestra storage URIs for inputs and outputs.

body.name: domain
body.title: DigitalOcean Domain
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean domain zones.
body.body: List, read, create, and delete domain zones. DNS records within a zone are managed by the io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain.record sub-package.

body.name: dropbox
body.title: Dropbox
body.description: Tasks that connect Kestra workflows to Dropbox.
body.body: Authenticate with a Dropbox access token to orchestrate file operations such as upload, download, listing, search, copy, move, delete, folder creation, and metadata retrieval; Dropbox paths should start with '/' and tasks can read or write via Kestra internal storage URIs.

body.name: volume
body.title: DigitalOcean Volume
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean block storage volumes.
body.body: List, read, create, and delete volumes, and attach or detach a volume from a droplet.

body.name: digitalocean
body.title: DigitalOcean
body.description: Manage DigitalOcean droplets, Kubernetes clusters, databases, load balancers, volumes, domains, and firewalls through the DigitalOcean API v2.

body.name: datahub
body.title: DataHub
body.description: Tasks that run DataHub CLI ingestions and interact with DataHub metadata.
body.body: Use this plugin to execute the DataHub ingestion CLI (default image `acryldata/datahub-ingestion:head`) against a provided recipe. Supply `recipe` as a map or Kestra storage URI; optionally set `containerImage`, `env`, and `taskRunner` for execution, plus `namespaceFiles`, `inputFiles`, and `outputFiles` to bundle dependencies and capture generated artifacts.

body.name: cli
body.title: Docker CLI
body.description: Docker tasks for building images, running containers, and managing artifacts from Kestra workflows.
body.body: Requires access to a Docker daemon via host socket or TCP endpoint; the caller inherits daemon permissions, so scope access carefully. Tasks cover build, image listing, push/pull, tagging, Compose execution, container lifecycle, and pruning. Registry auth is optional and set per task; pass tags, compose files, and run options explicitly.

body.name: record
body.title: DigitalOcean Domain Record
body.description: Tasks for managing DNS records within a DigitalOcean domain zone.
body.body: List, read, create, and delete DNS records under a domain zone already created (see io.kestra.plugin.digitalocean.domain to create the zone itself).

body.name: droplet
body.title: DigitalOcean Droplet
body.description: Tasks and a trigger for managing DigitalOcean droplets (virtual machines).
body.body: List, read, create, resize or run power actions on, and delete droplets. A polling trigger fires when a new droplet appears on the account.

body.name: loadbalancer
body.title: DigitalOcean Load Balancer
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean load balancers.
body.body: List, read, create, update, and delete load balancers, including their forwarding rules and attached droplets.

body.name: kubernetes
body.title: DigitalOcean Kubernetes
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters.
body.body: List, read, create, and delete Kubernetes clusters, and download a cluster's kubeconfig to internal storage.

body.name: database
body.title: DigitalOcean Database
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean managed database clusters.
body.body: List, read, create, resize, and delete managed database clusters (Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Kafka, OpenSearch).

body.name: firewall
body.title: DigitalOcean Firewall
body.description: Tasks for managing DigitalOcean cloud firewalls.
body.body: List, read, create, and delete cloud firewalls, including their inbound and outbound rules.

body.name: maas
body.title: MAAS
body.description: Tasks to automate provisioning and lifecycle management of bare-metal infrastructure using Canonical MAAS (Metal as a Service), providing cloud-like server deployment, inventory, and API-driven infrastructure workflows.
body.body: Automate the full bare-metal lifecycle on Canonical MAAS: `EnlistMachine` registers hardware, `CommissionMachine` inventories and validates it, `DeployMachine` installs an operating system, `PowerControlMachine` manages power state (on/off/cycle/query), and `ListMachines` queries the inventory with filters. All tasks authenticate with a MAAS `url` and an OAuth `apiKey` in `consumer:token:secret` format.

body.name: docker
body.title: Docker
body.description: Docker tasks for building images, running containers, and managing artifacts from Kestra workflows, plus managing AI models through the Docker Model Runner.
body.body: The `cli` subgroup requires access to a Docker daemon via host socket or TCP endpoint; the caller inherits daemon permissions, so scope access carefully. Its tasks cover build, image listing, push/pull, tagging, Compose execution, container lifecycle, and pruning. Registry auth is optional and set per task; pass tags, compose files, and run options explicitly. The separate `model` subgroup manages AI models through the Docker Model Runner (DMR) REST API and needs no Docker daemon.

body.name: model
body.title: Docker Model Runner
body.description: Tasks for managing AI models via the Docker Model Runner (DMR) REST API.
body.body: Calls the native DMR REST API at http://localhost:12434 (configurable via the host property). Does not require a Docker daemon or the docker model CLI. Covers pulling, listing, and deleting models.

body.name: hpe-morpheus
body.title: HPE Morpheus
body.description: Plugin for interacting with HPE Morpheus (HPE VM Essentials) cloud management platform

body.name: canonical
body.title: Canonical (EE)
body.description: Tasks to interact with Canonical services, enabling automation and infrastructure management through API-driven workflows.
body.body: Automate Canonical MAAS (Metal as a Service) bare-metal provisioning from Kestra — enlist, commission, deploy, power-control, and list machines through the MAAS API, authenticating with a MAAS `url` and OAuth `apiKey`.

body.name: replication
body.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Replication
body.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore replication: create rules, check session status, fail over, and synchronize on demand.

body.name: snapshots
body.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Snapshots
body.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

body.name: arrays
body.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Arrays
body.description: Tasks and triggers for monitoring Dell EMC PowerStore appliance health: alerts and performance metrics.

body.name: volumes
body.title: Dell EMC PowerStore Volumes
body.description: Tasks for managing Dell EMC PowerStore volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

body.name: dellemc
body.title: Dell EMC (EE)
body.description: Manage Dell EMC storage systems from Kestra, starting with PowerStore: volumes, snapshots, replication, and array/alert monitoring.

body.name: ml
body.title: Azure Machine Learning
body.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with Azure Machine Learning.
body.body: Submit and monitor training jobs and pipelines, register and retrieve model and data asset versions, and control compute clusters and instances directly within Kestra data pipelines.

body.name: auth
body.title: Azure Authentication
body.description: Tasks that obtain Azure access tokens for authenticated calls to other services.
body.body: Fetch Azure OAuth access tokens for downstream tasks using tenantId with either client secret, certificate, or DefaultAzureCredential. Configure scopes (defaults to https://management.azure.com/.default) and receive the encrypted token value with its expiration time in the outputs.

body.name: job
body.title: Azure Batch Job
body.description: Tasks that create and supervise Azure Batch jobs and their tasks.
body.body: Create and supervise Azure Batch jobs and their tasks. Provide the Batch account endpoint, account name, access key, and poolId, then define tasks (commands, containers, files, outputs); jobs can wait for completion while emitting timing and task count metrics and returning logs or outputs.

body.name: cli
body.title: Azure CLI
body.description: Tasks that run Azure CLI commands within Kestra.
body.body: Provide one or more commands with optional service principal login (tenant, username/clientId, password/secret); runs in the Azure CLI container or chosen task runner and supports environment variables plus file inputs/outputs.

body.name: adls
body.title: ADLS
body.description: Tasks that work with Azure Data Lake Storage for large-scale file operations and analytics workloads.
body.body: Upload, read, list, and delete ADLS Gen2 files, generate shared access links, or trigger workflows on storage events. Provide an endpoint with either a connection string, shared key, or SAS token plus the target fileSystem and filePath; optional leasing can prevent concurrent writes.

body.name: f5
body.title: F5 BIG-IP (EE)
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM nodes, pools, pool members, virtual servers, and health monitors via the iControl REST API.

body.name: monitor
body.title: F5 BIG-IP Monitor
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM health monitors (http, tcp, icmp).

body.name: pool
body.title: F5 BIG-IP Pool
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM pools (load-balancing server groups).

body.name: node
body.title: F5 BIG-IP Node
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM nodes (backend IP registrations).

body.name: svm
body.title: NetApp ONTAP SVMs
body.description: Tasks for querying NetApp ONTAP Storage Virtual Machines (SVMs).

body.name: blob
body.title: Azure Blob Storage
body.description: Tasks that manage data in Azure Blob Storage for object and file workflows.
body.body: Upload or download single files and collections, copy between locations, list and delete blobs, create SAS links, or trigger workflows on container events. Provide an endpoint with a connection string, shared key, or SAS token plus the container name and blob path.

body.name: netapp
body.title: NetApp ONTAP (EE)
body.description: Manage NetApp ONTAP clusters from Kestra: volumes, snapshots, SnapMirror replication, and SVMs.

body.name: pool
body.title: Azure Batch Pool
body.description: Tasks that scale and manage Azure Batch pools.
body.body: Scale and manage Azure Batch pools by adjusting dedicated or low-priority nodes. Authenticate with the Batch endpoint, account, and accessKey, then resize pools and wait until they are active; outputs surface the resulting pool sizing for downstream scheduling decisions.

body.name: virtualserver
body.title: F5 BIG-IP Virtual Server
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM virtual servers (public-facing listeners).

body.name: poolmember
body.title: F5 BIG-IP Pool Member
body.description: Manage F5 BIG-IP LTM pool members (node and port attachments to pools).

body.name: ontap
body.title: NetApp ONTAP
body.description: Core tasks and shared infrastructure for the NetApp ONTAP REST API plugin.

body.name: hpoo
body.title: HP OO (EE)
body.description: Trigger and manage HP Operations Orchestration (OpenText OO) flows from Kestra.
body.body: Supports both Classic OO (REST v2, HTTP Basic auth) and Containerized OO (REST v1, token auth).

body.name: volumes
body.title: NetApp ONTAP Volumes
body.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

body.name: azure
body.title: Azure
body.description: Leverage Microsoft Azure services within Kestra data workflows.

body.name: executions
body.title: HP OO Executions
body.description: Tasks to run, monitor, and control HP Operations Orchestration (OpenText OO) flow executions.
body.body: Provide the OO Central host, API mode (Classic or Containerized), and credentials to trigger flows, poll for completion, retrieve execution summaries and step logs, and change execution state (cancel, pause, resume).

body.name: update
body.title: Azure Data Lake Storage Update
body.description: Tasks that update files in Azure Data Lake Storage (append, lease, access control).

body.name: table
body.title: Azure Table Storage
body.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Table Storage entities.
body.body: List, query, retrieve, insert, or delete rows using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint plus the table name; supply partition/row keys for targeted operations or filter expressions for bulk queries and upserts.

body.name: replication
body.title: NetApp ONTAP SnapMirror Replication
body.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP SnapMirror replication relationships.

body.name: snapshots
body.title: NetApp ONTAP Snapshots
body.description: Tasks for managing NetApp ONTAP volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

body.name: synapse
body.title: Azure Synapse
body.description: Tasks for Azure Synapse Analytics to submit and manage Spark batch jobs on Synapse Spark pools.
body.body: Provide Azure AD credentials plus workspace endpoint and Spark pool name; submit Spark batch jobs with application files, arguments, and resource configurations for distributed data processing.

body.name: durable
body.title: Azure HorizonDB Durable Workflows
body.description: Submit, cancel, signal, inspect, list, and react to pg_durable durable function instances on Azure HorizonDB.
body.body: Start durable function instances from a pg_durable SQL DSL body, cancel or signal running instances, poll status and results, list instances filtered by status, and trigger a flow when an instance reaches a target status.

body.name: cosmosdb
body.title: Cosmos DB
body.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Cosmos DB.
body.body: Create, query, batch, and delete Cosmos DB container items using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint.

body.name: function
body.title: Azure Function
body.description: Tasks that invoke Azure Functions over HTTP and return responses to flows.
body.body: Trigger Azure Functions over HTTP and capture their responses for downstream steps. Provide the function URL (including function key), choose the HTTP method, and pass an optional JSON body; configurable timeouts help avoid long-running calls, and responses are returned as parsed JSON when possible.

body.name: elasticsearch
body.title: Elasticsearch (EE)
body.description: Tasks that push Kestra data to Elasticsearch clusters for search and analytics.
body.body: Use these tasks to bulk-export execution logs into a target index via Elasticsearch’s REST API. Configure hosts (with scheme/port), optional basic auth and headers, and tune bulk chunk size to balance throughput and memory.

body.name: horizondb
body.title: Azure HorizonDB
body.description: Tasks and triggers to run SQL queries and manage pg_durable durable workflows on Azure HorizonDB.
body.body: Connect with password or Azure Entra ID authentication; run single or multi-statement SQL queries with FETCH, FETCH_ONE, or STORE result handling, and submit, cancel, signal, inspect, list, and react to pg_durable durable function instances directly from a Kestra flow.

body.name: eventhubs
body.title: Azure Event Hubs
body.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger on Azure Event Hubs streams.
body.body: Supply the namespace, eventHubName, and connectionString; consumers set a consumerGroup and blob checkpoint store (container name and connection string) with starting positions, while producers support multiple body serializers for sending events.

body.name: aifoundry
body.title: Azure AI Foundry
body.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with Azure AI Foundry.
body.body: Leverage Microsoft's unified platform for building, evaluating, and deploying AI models. Perform chat completions, generate embeddings, run persistent agents, and retrieve deployment information directly within Kestra data pipelines.

body.name: logicapps
body.title: Azure Logic Apps
body.description: Tasks and triggers for running and monitoring Azure Logic Apps workflows.
body.body: Authenticate using an Azure AD service principal (tenantId, clientId, clientSecret, optionally pemCertificate) and provide subscriptionId, resourceGroupName, and workflowName. Use Run to trigger workflows and surface the new runId from the Location header, GetRun and ListRuns to inspect executions, Get and List for workflow metadata, and Trigger to react to completed or failed runs. List supports maxWorkflows to cap large resource groups.

body.name: monitoring
body.title: Azure Monitoring
body.description: Tasks that query or ingest metrics with Azure Monitor.
body.body: Configure the regional metrics endpoint plus Azure AD credentials; metric queries accept resourceIds, metricNames, namespace, time window, aggregations, filters, and intervals, while ingestion posts custom metrics using managed bearer-token acquisition.

body.name: graylog
body.title: Graylog (EE)
body.description: Tasks that ship Kestra execution logs to Graylog through GELF HTTP inputs.
body.body: Use these tasks to centralize Flow logs in Graylog or downstream SIEMs; configure the required `endpoint` to the GELF HTTP input, optionally adjust `chunk` for batch size (default 1000) and `graylogHost` for the GELF host field (default Kestra), and supply HTTP client options if custom timeouts or authentication are needed.

body.name: flink
body.title: Apache Flink
body.description: Tasks that submit, monitor, cancel, and trigger savepoints for Apache Flink jobs over the REST API.
body.body: Provide the Flink JobManager REST `restUrl` plus job details such as `jarUri`, `entryClass`, args, parallelism, and optional savepoint paths to upload and run jobs, monitor status, cancel executions, or trigger savepoints directly from Kestra.

body.name: OpenLineage
body.title: OpenLineage
body.description: Tasks that push Kestra asset lineage events to OpenLineage endpoints
body.body: Use this plugin to publish asset lineage over HTTP to OpenLineage-compatible collectors. Configure the destination `uri` and optional per-asset mappings for dataset namespace/name; ensure the endpoint accepts OpenLineage events.

body.name: faktory
body.title: Faktory
body.description: Faktory plugin for Kestra

body.name: servicebus
body.title: Azure Service Bus
body.description: Tasks that interact with Azure Service Bus.
body.body: Consume, Publish, Trigger, and RealTimeTrigger tasks from Azure Service Bus using a connection string or SAS/shared key and endpoint.

body.name: elasticsearch
body.title: Elasticsearch
body.description: Tasks that query and write to Elasticsearch clusters for search, indexing, bulk ingestion, and ES|QL.
body.body: Configure a shared connection with cluster hosts (and optional basic auth, headers, path prefixes, or trust-all SSL) and supply index names plus search DSL or ES|QL payloads to run. Covers single-document writes and reads, bulk/streaming ingestion, REST requests, and search or scroll operations with controls for routing, refresh policy, and storing or fetching results for downstream steps.

body.name: streamanalytics
body.title: Azure Stream Analytics
body.description: Tasks for interacting with Azure Stream Analytics jobs.
body.body: Authenticate using an Azure AD service principal (tenantId, clientId, clientSecret) and interact with Azure Stream Analytics jobs. Tasks return job metadata such as provisioning state and runtime state, useful for building conditional flows or monitoring streaming workloads.

body.name: datafactory
body.title: Azure Data Factory
body.description: Tasks that start and monitor Azure Data Factory pipelines for ETL and integration.
body.body: Provide Azure AD credentials plus subscriptionId, resourceGroupName, factoryName, and pipelineName; pass pipeline parameters as needed and choose to wait for completion to collect activity counts and run duration metrics.

body.name: huawei
body.title: Huawei Cloud (EE)
body.description: Enterprise Huawei Cloud plugin for Kestra — integrates Huawei Cloud services into EE workflows.
body.body: Provides log export to Huawei Cloud Log Tank Service (LTS) and a Cloud Container Instance (CCI) task runner; configure the region, project ID, and credentials or inline STS credential exchange to push execution logs in batches to any LTS log stream, or to run Kestra workloads as Pods on a CCI namespace.

body.name: lts
body.title: Huawei Cloud LTS Log Exporter
body.description: Exports Kestra execution logs to Huawei Cloud Log Tank Service (LTS) streams.
body.body: Configure logGroupId and logStreamId along with region and credentials to push execution logs in batches; adjust chunk to balance throughput and LTS API usage while emitting request and log counters.

body.name: stats
body.title: Fastly Stats
body.description: Tasks that pull historical Fastly analytics: requests, bandwidth, cache hit/miss, hit ratio, status codes, and usage breakdowns.
body.body: Query historical Fastly analytics at any granularity. Supports per-service stats, account-wide aggregates, bandwidth and request usage by region or service, month-to-date totals, and a polling trigger that fires when a chosen field metric crosses a configured threshold.

body.name: comments
body.title: Comments
body.description: List, create, and delete comments on Figma files.
body.body: List a file's comments, post a new comment (optionally pinned to a canvas position or as a reply), or delete an existing comment.

body.name: opentelemetry
body.title: Opentelemetry (EE)
body.description: Tasks that export Kestra logs to an OpenTelemetry collector over OTLP.
body.body: Use these tasks when you need to forward workflow logs to an OTLP endpoint for centralized observability; set `otlpEndpoint` (required), optionally add authorization headers, and tune `chunk` size (default 1000) to control batch throughput while emitting request and log count metrics.

body.name: purge
body.title: Fastly Cache Purge
body.description: Tasks that invalidate Fastly cached content by URL, surrogate key, or globally for a service.
body.body: Invalidate cached content on Fastly's edge network. Supports URL purge, surrogate key purge (single and batch), and full service cache flush. Soft purge is available on all endpoints except purge-all.

body.name: figma
body.title: Figma
body.description: Tasks and triggers to interact with the Figma REST API.
body.body: Read Figma file documents and export node images, manage file comments, list team projects and their files, read and write variables (Enterprise plan required), and trigger a flow whenever a Figma file changes.

body.name: files
body.title: Files
body.description: Read Figma file documents and export node images.
body.body: Get a file's full document structure, or export one or more nodes as PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF images.

body.name: projects
body.title: Projects
body.description: List Figma team projects and the files within a project.
body.body: List all projects of a team, or all files within a project.

body.name: fastly
body.title: Fastly
body.description: Tasks related to Fastly services

body.name: crowdstrike-ioc
body.title: CrowdStrike IOC
body.description: Tasks for creating, updating, deleting, and searching custom indicators of compromise (IOCs) in CrowdStrike Falcon.
body.body: Create, update, delete, and search custom IOCs (domains, IPs, and file hashes) with configurable action and severity.

body.name: runner
body.title: Huawei Cloud CCI Task Runner
body.description: Task runner that executes Kestra workloads as Pods on Huawei Cloud Cloud Container Instance (CCI).
body.body: Requires `region`, `namespace` (an existing CCI namespace bound to a VPC Network), and Huawei Cloud credentials — `accessKeyId`/`secretAccessKey` (AK/SK signing, recommended), `temporaryCredentials`, or a pre-obtained IAM token via `securityToken`; the same AK/SK also covers the `bucket` used by `inputFiles`, `outputFiles`, or working directory sync, ensure the task defines a `containerImage`, and tune `resources`, polling, and resume/cleanup options to fit your CCI environment.

body.name: new-relic
body.title: New Relic (EE)
body.description: Tasks that ship Kestra logs to New Relic's Logs API for centralized monitoring.
body.body: Use the LogExporter tasks to forward buffered log records over HTTPS to New Relic; set `basePath` to your New Relic log ingest endpoint and provide an `apiKey` (license or ingest key). Tune optional HTTP `options` and the `chunk` size to control batching, retries, and throughput.

body.name: connectors
body.title: Fivetran Connectors
body.description: Tasks that trigger and manage Fivetran connector syncs.
body.body: Start a connector sync through the Fivetran API and optionally wait for completion or failure, including a force-restart option. Requires API key/secret credentials and a `connectorId`; you can override the API base URL, HTTP options, and tune `force`, `wait`, and `maxDuration` to match your run policies.

body.name: fivetran
body.title: Fivetran
body.description: Tasks that orchestrate Fivetran connectors to automate data movement in Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use these tasks to call the Fivetran API from Kestra pipelines, such as triggering connector syncs with built-in waiting and monitoring. Provide your Fivetran API key/secret (typically via secrets), and optionally override the API base URL or HTTP client options.

body.name: variables
body.title: Variables
body.description: Read and write Figma variables and variable collections. Requires a Figma Enterprise organization plan.
body.body: Get a file's local or published variables, or bulk create/update/delete variables, variable collections, modes, and mode values. All three tasks require a Figma Enterprise organization plan with variables enabled.

body.name: triggers
body.title: Triggers
body.description: Poll Figma files for changes and start a flow execution.
body.body: Poll a Figma file and start an execution whenever its `lastModified` timestamp advances.

body.name: dash0
body.title: Dash0 (EE)
body.description: Tasks that ship Kestra workflow logs to Dash0 via OTLP/HTTP for centralized observability.
body.body: Use the LogExporter with the Dash0 OTLP/HTTP ingestion endpoint and a Bearer auth token to push run logs into a chosen Dash0 dataset. Pair it with a LogShipper to automate exports on a schedule.

body.name: crowdstrike-spotlight
body.title: CrowdStrike Spotlight
body.description: Tasks and triggers for searching vulnerabilities detected by CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight.
body.body: Search Spotlight vulnerabilities with FQL, with FetchType support for large result sets, and trigger a flow on new vulnerabilities.

body.name: crowdstrike-hosts
body.title: CrowdStrike Hosts
body.description: Tasks for searching, fetching, containing, and tagging hosts (devices) managed by CrowdStrike Falcon.
body.body: Search device IDs with FQL, fetch host details, contain or release network containment, and add or remove grouping tags.

body.name: crowdstrike-alerts
body.title: CrowdStrike Alerts
body.description: Tasks and triggers for querying, fetching, and updating CrowdStrike Falcon alerts.
body.body: Query alert IDs with FQL, fetch full alert details, bulk-update status/assignment/comments, and trigger a flow on new alerts.

body.name: crowdstrike-intel
body.title: CrowdStrike Intel
body.description: Tasks for searching CrowdStrike Falcon threat intelligence: actors, reports, and indicators.
body.body: Search threat actors, intelligence reports, and indicators with FQL, and download report PDFs to internal storage.

body.name: crowdstrike
body.title: CrowdStrike (EE)
body.description: CrowdStrike Falcon plugin for Kestra
body.body: Query, fetch, and update CrowdStrike Falcon alerts, hosts, indicators of compromise, Spotlight vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence.

body.name: job
body.title: Azure Batch
body.description: Tasks that provision and supervise Azure Batch jobs and task executions.
body.body: Create Batch jobs with one or more tasks, wait for completion with optional timeouts, and resume existing runs when allowed while pushing task outputs back to internal storage; requires the Batch `endpoint`, `account`, and `poolId` plus job and task definitions, with `accessKey` for shared-key authentication and optional `delete`, `resume`, and `maxDuration` controls.

body.name: opa
body.title: OPA (Open Policy Agent)
body.description: Tasks to manage Open Policy Agent policies and decisions, including upload, evaluation, and partial evaluation.

body.name: policy
body.title: Policies
body.description: Tasks for managing OPA policies: upload, list, delete, evaluate, and compile decisions.

body.name: runner
body.title: Azure Runner
body.description: Tasks that run Kestra workloads on Azure Batch pools or Azure Virtual Machines, with live log streaming.
body.body: Use the Batch task runner to execute containerized tasks on an existing Batch pool, resume jobs when possible, and stream stdout/stderr; requires `endpoint`, `account`, `accessKey`, `poolId`, and a `containerImage`, plus `blobStorage` when exchanging input, output, or namespace files. Use the VirtualMachine task runner to execute tasks natively (no container) on a launched or reused Azure VM via the Run Command API. It requires `subscriptionId` and `resourceGroupName`, plus `region`/`vmSize`/`subnetId` (an already existing subnet) when provisioning a new VM, or `vmName` to target an already existing VM instead, and `blobStorage` when exchanging input, output, or namespace files. A VM targeted through `vmName` is never stopped or deleted by this runner.

body.name: monitor
body.title: Azure Monitor Log Exporter
body.description: Tasks that send observability data to Azure Monitor Log Ingestion endpoints.
body.body: Exports Kestra logs to a Data Collection Rule stream with configurable chunking and error metrics; requires the ingestion `endpoint`, `ruleId`, and `streamName`, and authenticates with Azure AD credentials (tenant/client/secret or certificate) or the default Azure credential chain.

body.name: storage
body.title: Azure Storage Log Exporter
body.description: Log exporter that ships Kestra execution logs to Azure Blob Storage.
body.body: Ships Kestra execution logs to Azure Blob Storage append blobs in JSON or ION, rolling files by a maximum line count; configure the storage `endpoint` with a connection string, shared key, or SAS credentials and provide the target `containerName`.

body.name: blob
body.title: Azure Blob Storage
body.description: Tasks for interacting with Azure Blob Storage.
body.body: List blobs in a container with optional prefix and regexp filters, and generate time-bound SAS URIs granting specific permissions on a blob; configure the storage `endpoint` with a connection string, shared key, or SAS credentials and provide the target `container` and blob `name`.

body.name: azure
body.title: Azure (EE)
body.description: Tasks that integrate Microsoft Azure services into Kestra enterprise workflows.
body.body: Provides Azure Batch execution, storage utilities, and log export capabilities; configure each task with the appropriate Azure endpoint plus keys, SAS tokens, or Azure AD credentials depending on the service.

body.name: gitlab
body.title: GitLab
body.description: Tasks that interact with GitLab projects, commits, and issues via the API.
body.body: Provide a GitLab host name and access token with project identifiers to search commits, create or update issues, and retrieve project metadata for CI/CD or governance workflows.

body.name: issues
body.title: GitLab Issues
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch GitLab issues.
body.body: Set the GitLab host name, project ID, and access token to file issues with title/description, add comments or updates, and list or retrieve issue details for triage workflows.

body.name: mergerequests
body.title: GitLab Merge Requests
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and fetch GitLab Merge Requests.
body.body: Set the GitLab host name, project ID, and access token to handle Merge Requests.

body.name: gemini
body.title: Gemini
body.description: Tasks that call Google Gemini models for text, chat, structured outputs, multimodal prompts, and video generation.
body.body: Provide your Gemini `apiKey` and target `model` to send prompts for text, chat, or video creation, including structured and multimodal requests, and receive predictions with usage metrics you can route through flows.

body.name: purestorage
body.title: Pure Storage FlashArray (EE)
body.description: Manage Pure Storage FlashArray systems from Kestra: volumes, snapshots, ActiveDR pods, and array/alert monitoring.

body.name: snapshots
body.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Snapshots
body.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray volume snapshots: create, list, delete, and restore.

body.name: volumes
body.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Volumes
body.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray volumes: list, get, create, resize, and delete.

body.name: pods
body.title: Pure Storage FlashArray ActiveDR Pods
body.description: Tasks for managing Pure Storage FlashArray ActiveDR pods: list, get, create, promote, and demote.

body.name: arrays
body.title: Pure Storage FlashArray Arrays
body.description: Tasks and triggers for monitoring Pure Storage FlashArray array status and alerts.

body.name: process
body.title: RunMyJobs Process
body.description: Submit and monitor Redwood RunMyJobs Process Definitions.

body.name: runmyjobs
body.title: RunMyJobs
body.description: Redwood RunMyJobs plugin for Kestra

body.name: email
body.title: Email
body.description: Tasks that send email notifications.
body.body: Configure SMTP server/port, credentials, from/to addresses, subject, and body/attachments to send emails from workflows; supports TLS/SSL settings for secure delivery.

body.name: salesforce
body.title: Salesforce (EE)
body.description: Tasks that connect to Salesforce in Kestra to query data, manage records, and trigger flows from CRM events.
body.body: Use the Partner API with a `connection` (username, password, authEndpoint) to run SOQL queries, create, update, or delete objects, and trigger flows from query results. Provide object API names, record IDs, or SOQL statements along with fetch options when you need to return or store rows for downstream tasks.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam-ipnode
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM IP Nodes
body.description: List, get, allocate, release, and update individual IP node records in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.
body.body: Manage IP node records in SolarWinds Orion IPAM: list nodes by subnet or status, retrieve individual nodes by ID, allocate new IP addresses via two-phase reservation, release addresses back to available, and update DNS names or status.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam-supernet
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM Supernets
body.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM supernet aggregations in SolarWinds Orion.
body.body: Manage IPAM supernet aggregations in SolarWinds Orion: list all supernets, retrieve individual supernets by ID, create new aggregation blocks, update existing supernets, and delete them when they are no longer needed.

body.name: solarwinds
body.title: SolarWinds Orion (EE)
body.description: Manage SolarWinds Orion IPAM resources — subnets, IP nodes, groups, DHCP scopes, and supernets — via the SolarWinds Information Service (SWIS) REST API.
body.body: Automate SolarWinds IPAM workflows: list and allocate IP addresses, create subnets and groups, query the network with SWQL, and trigger executions on utilization breaches or IP status changes.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam-group
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM Groups
body.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM group hierarchy nodes in SolarWinds Orion.
body.body: Manage the IPAM group hierarchy in SolarWinds Orion: list all groups or filter by parent, retrieve individual groups by ID, create new hierarchy nodes, update existing groups, and delete them when they are no longer needed.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam-subnet
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM Subnets
body.description: List, get, create, update, and delete IPAM subnets in SolarWinds Orion.
body.body: Manage IPAM subnets in SolarWinds Orion: list with utilization statistics, retrieve individual subnets by ID, create new subnet definitions, update existing ones, and delete subnets when they are no longer needed.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM
body.description: Tasks for IP address management in SolarWinds Orion.
body.body: Execute SWQL queries, manage subnets, allocate and release IP addresses, organize groups, inspect DHCP scopes, and aggregate supernets in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.

body.name: auth
body.title: GitHub Authentication
body.description: Tasks that issue GitHub access credentials.
body.body: Sign a JWT with a GitHub App's RSA private key and exchange it for a short-lived installation access token. Pass the returned token to downstream `io.kestra.plugin.github.*` tasks via `appInstallationToken`.

body.name: solarwinds-ipam-dhcpscope
body.title: SolarWinds IPAM DHCP Scopes
body.description: List and get DHCP scopes tracked in SolarWinds Orion IPAM.
body.body: Inspect DHCP scopes tracked in SolarWinds Orion IPAM: list all scopes or filter by subnet ID, and retrieve individual scope details including address range and DHCP server association.

body.name: syslog
body.title: Syslog (EE)
body.description: Export Kestra execution and audit logs to a Syslog collector or SIEM in CEF format over UDP, TCP, or TLS.

body.name: code
body.title: GitHub Code
body.description: Tasks that search GitHub source code through the API.
body.body: Use a GitHub token with search queries, languages, and repo qualifiers to retrieve matching code results and metadata you can route to review or inventory workflows.

body.name: github
body.title: GitHub
body.description: Tasks that search GitHub and manage issues, pulls, and workflows.
body.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token and repository/org details to search code, commits, repos, users, topics; create or comment on issues and pull requests; and dispatch Actions workflows, returning API payloads for orchestration.

body.name: pulls
body.title: GitHub Pull Requests
body.description: Tasks that search and open GitHub pull requests.
body.body: Use a GitHub token with owner/repo, base/head branches, and PR metadata (title, body, reviewers) to create pull requests or search existing ones, returning PR details for review flows.

body.name: veeam
body.title: Veeam (EE)
body.description: Enterprise Veeam Backup & Replication tasks and triggers to manage jobs, monitor sessions, and trigger restores over the VBR REST API.
body.body: Automate Veeam Backup & Replication: list, inspect, start, and stop jobs, poll job sessions until completion, retrieve session logs, trigger instant VM recovery or file-level restore, and react to job completions with a polling trigger.

body.name: issues
body.title: GitHub Issues
body.description: Tasks that search, create, and comment on GitHub issues.
body.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token, set repository owner/name, and supply search terms or issue payloads (title, body, labels, assignees) to file issues, add comments, or retrieve issue metadata for triage.

body.name: users
body.title: GitHub Users
body.description: Tasks that search GitHub users.
body.body: Use a GitHub token with search criteria such as name, org, or location to list users and return profile metadata for audits or onboarding workflows.

body.name: jobs
body.title: Veeam Jobs
body.description: Tasks and triggers for listing, inspecting, starting, and stopping Veeam Backup & Replication jobs.
body.body: List, get, start, and stop Veeam Backup & Replication jobs, and trigger a flow whenever a job session completes.

body.name: topics
body.title: GitHub Topics
body.description: Tasks that search GitHub topics.
body.body: Provide a GitHub token and topic query to retrieve topic metadata and related repositories for categorization or discovery workflows.

body.name: events
body.title: Splunk Events
body.description: Tasks for sending and querying Splunk events.
body.body: Use Send to ingest event data via the HTTP Event Collector (HEC) and Search to run SPL queries against the Splunk management API.

body.name: projects
body.title: GitHub Projects
body.description: Tasks for listing and managing GitHub Projects v2 boards.
body.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token that has the read:project scope and supply an organization login and project number to fetch all items from a GitHub Projects v2 board, with optional filtering by owner, status, and labels.

body.name: splunk
body.title: Splunk (EE)
body.description: Tasks that send Kestra logs to Splunk via HTTP Event Collector for centralized search and monitoring.
body.body: Use when forwarding workflow logs to Splunk HEC; requires the HEC base URL and token. Supports batching (default 1,000 events) and optional HTTP client settings for TLS, proxies, and timeouts.

body.name: loki
body.title: Grafana-loki
body.description: Tasks that execute LogQL against Grafana Loki and trigger workflows from log patterns.
body.body: Set the Loki `url`, auth token or basic credentials, and LogQL `query` along with time range, direction, and limits to fetch logs or metrics, or use the polling trigger to start flows when new matching entries arrive.

body.name: restores
body.title: Veeam Restores
body.description: Tasks for triggering Veeam Backup & Replication instant VM recovery and file-level restore sessions.
body.body: Trigger instant VM recovery or file-level restore mounts from a restore point, then wait for completion with sessions.Get.

body.name: actions
body.title: GitHub Actions
body.description: Tasks that dispatch and monitor GitHub Actions workflows.
body.body: Provide a GitHub token, owner/repo, workflow file or ID, and ref/inputs to trigger workflows and retrieve run details so you can orchestrate CI/CD directly from Kestra.

body.name: repositories
body.title: GitHub Repositories
body.description: Tasks that search and inspect GitHub repositories.
body.body: Authenticate with a GitHub token and supply search queries, topics, owners, or visibility filters to list repositories and return metadata such as stars, forks, and languages for inventory or compliance checks.

body.name: commits
body.title: GitHub Commits
body.description: Tasks that search and list GitHub commits.
body.body: Provide a GitHub token with repository details and search filters (branch, author, query) to retrieve commit metadata, hashes, and messages for auditing or downstream processing.

body.name: sessions
body.title: Veeam Sessions
body.description: Tasks for listing, inspecting, and retrieving logs of Veeam Backup & Replication job sessions.
body.body: List sessions, get a single session with optional polling until completion, and retrieve session logs to internal storage.

body.name: sheets
body.title: Google Sheets
body.description: Tasks that read, write, create, delete, and watch Google Sheets.
body.body: Provide Sheets/Drive scopes, spreadsheet IDs, ranges, and optional value/input options to read or load data, create or delete spreadsheets, and use the sheet modification trigger to launch flows on updates.

body.name: grafana
body.title: Grafana
body.description: Tasks that query Grafana Loki and react to log and metric results with LogQL.
body.body: Configure the Loki base `url`, authentication token or tenant, and LogQL `query` to run instant or range queries or emit triggers on matching log streams, returning timestamps, labels, and counts you can use downstream.

body.name: hightouch
body.title: Hightouch
body.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor Hightouch syncs.
body.body: Provide a Hightouch API token and sync ID to start a sync, optionally wait for completion, and retrieve run status, modified rows, and errors for reverse ETL orchestration.

body.name: chat
body.title: Google Chat
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Google Chat.
body.body: Provide the Google Chat webhook URL and message text (or cards) to post notifications from Kestra into Chat rooms.

body.name: googleworkspace
body.title: Google Workspace
body.description: Tasks that work with Google Workspace services (Chat, Drive, Calendar, Mail, Sheets).
body.body: Configure OAuth or service-account credentials with required scopes to send and receive Gmail, manage Drive files and exports, create or list Calendar events, and read/write Sheets data with triggers for new mail, files, or sheet changes.

body.name: deals
body.title: HubSpot Deals
body.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot deals.
body.body: Provide your HubSpot token along with pipeline/stage, amounts, and related contact/company IDs to manage deals, search with filters, and remove records, returning deal payloads for revenue operations workflows.

body.name: graphql
body.title: GraphQL
body.description: Tasks that send GraphQL queries and mutations over HTTP endpoints.
body.body: Define the GraphQL `url`, `query`, and optional `variables` or custom headers to call APIs, with responses returned as JSON you can store, filter, or pass to downstream tasks.

body.name: drive
body.title: Google Drive
body.description: Tasks that upload, download, export, list, and watch files in Google Drive.
body.body: Use OAuth or service-account credentials with Drive scopes and a parent folder or file ID to upload or create files, export Google Docs formats, download content, list files, delete items, and trigger flows when new files appear.

body.name: hubspot
body.title: HubSpot
body.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot CRM objects.
body.body: Provide a HubSpot private app token and object details to manage contacts, companies, deals, and tickets, using search filters or property payloads and receiving the API responses for downstream automation.

body.name: mail
body.title: Google Mail
body.description: Tasks that send, read, and trigger on Google Mail messages.
body.body: Authenticate with Gmail scopes, specify the user email, and provide message content or search queries to send mail, list or fetch messages (with attachments), and enable a trigger to start flows when new messages arrive.

body.name: contacts
body.title: HubSpot Contacts
body.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot contacts.
body.body: Use your HubSpot token with contact properties (emails, names, custom fields) to insert or update records, search by filters, and remove contacts by ID while capturing API responses for enrichment flows.

body.name: tickets
body.title: HubSpot Tickets
body.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot tickets.
body.body: Use your HubSpot token with ticket properties (subject, content, pipeline/stage) to open or update support tickets, search via filters, and delete by ID while capturing responses for support workflows.

body.name: hex
body.title: Hex
body.description: Run Hex (hex.tech) notebook and app projects from Kestra and react when a run completes.
body.body: Use the `projects.Run` task to start the latest published version of a Hex project and optionally wait for it to finish, or the `projects.Trigger` to fire a flow when a project's most recent run reaches COMPLETED. Requires a Hex `apiToken` and a `projectId`; override `baseUrl` only for a self-hosted Hex region.

body.name: companies
body.title: HubSpot Companies
body.description: Tasks that create, update, search, and delete HubSpot companies.
body.body: Set your HubSpot token and company properties to create or update records, search with filters, or delete by ID, returning company payloads for CRM workflows.

body.name: calendar
body.title: Google Calendar
body.description: Tasks that create, update, delete, and watch Google Calendar events.
body.body: Provide OAuth or service-account credentials with Calendar scopes plus calendar IDs to insert, update, list, or delete events, and enable the event trigger to launch flows when new events are created.

body.name: projects
body.title: Hex Projects
body.description: Run a Hex project and react when a run completes.
body.body: Start the latest published version of a Hex project and optionally wait for completion, or trigger a flow when a project's most recent run reaches COMPLETED. Requires an `apiToken` (Hex API key) and a `projectId`; override `baseUrl` only for a self-hosted Hex region.

body.name: huggingface
body.title: Huggingface
body.description: Tasks that call Hugging Face Inference APIs.
body.body: Set your Hugging Face token, model endpoint, and payload (text, image, or other inputs) to run hosted models via the Inference API and return predictions for downstream tasks.

body.name: jenkins
body.title: Jenkins
body.description: Tasks that trigger Jenkins jobs and retrieve build or job metadata.
body.body: Provide the Jenkins `serverUrl` with a username and API token to start parameterized builds and query job or build details; the tasks handle crumb headers via the HTTP configuration and surface queue, status, and artifact information for orchestration.

body.name: issues
body.title: Jira Issues
body.description: Tasks that file, update, comment on, and search Jira issues.
body.body: Set Jira connection details and credentials, provide project keys, issue types/fields, and JQL to create or update issues, add comments, or retrieve issue details for workflow automation.

body.name: jira
body.title: Atlassian Jira
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and search Jira issues.
body.body: Provide Jira cloud/server URL with user/API token or PAT, project keys, and issue fields to create or modify issues, add comments, or search via JQL, returning issue payloads for incident and backlog workflows.

body.name: influxdb
body.title: InfluxDB
body.description: Tasks that query and write time series data in InfluxDB.
body.body: Provide connection details (URL, org, bucket, token, or username/password) to run Flux or InfluxQL queries, write points, load files, or trigger flows on query results, with optional time ranges and precision settings.

body.name: jobs
body.title: Klaviyo Campaign Jobs
body.description: Tasks that check Klaviyo campaign job status and recipients.
