body.body: Set your `apiKey` with job or recipient IDs to poll campaign send jobs and fetch recipient batches, returning job states, errors, and payloads so you can monitor delivery pipelines.

body.name: kvm
body.title: KVM / Libvirt
body.description: Manage KVM virtual machines using the Libvirt API.
body.body: Use these tasks to define, start, stop, and delete virtual machines, update configurations, and list active or inactive domains directly from Kestra workflows. They require access to a libvirtd daemon (via local socket, SSH, or TLS) and accept task-specific settings such as XML definitions, power-state flags, and resource cleanup options for persistent storage. The included trigger allows for automated responses to VM lifecycle events, such as state transitions or unexpected shutdowns.

body.name: issues
body.title: Linear Issues
body.description: Tasks that file, update, and retrieve Linear issues.
body.body: Provide a Linear API key with team/workspace context to create issues with required fields, update existing issues, or fetch issue data for synchronization and reporting.

body.name: linear
body.title: Linear
body.description: Tasks that create, update, and search Linear issues.
body.body: Set a Linear API key and workspace/team details to file issues with titles/descriptions, update statuses or labels, and query issues for planning workflows.

body.name: line
body.title: Line
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to LINE messaging.
body.body: Provide the LINE channel access token and target user/group to push messages from Kestra, supporting text content and optional attributes.

body.name: messages
body.title: Klaviyo Campaign Messages
body.description: Tasks that retrieve Klaviyo campaign messages and their media assets.
body.body: Use the `apiKey` with campaign or message IDs to list messages, fetch message details, and download image assets so you can validate content before sending or archive creative variants.

body.name: campaign
body.title: Klaviyo Campaign
body.description: Tasks that fetch Klaviyo campaign details and recipient counts.
body.body: Provide the Klaviyo `apiKey`, `campaignIds`, and fetch strategy to list campaign metadata or counts, respecting API revision headers and rate delays so you can audit targeting, status, and delivery readiness in flows.

body.name: klaviyo
body.title: Klaviyo
body.description: Tasks that interact with Klaviyo campaign APIs.
body.body: Use your Klaviyo `apiKey` and base URL to retrieve campaigns, their jobs, and message assets, applying fetch strategies to return single items, lists, or stored files for further segmentation or reporting.

body.name: kubernetes
body.title: Kubernetes
body.description: Tasks that run workloads and kubectl operations against Kubernetes clusters.
body.body: Provide cluster connection details (in-cluster, kubeconfig, or explicit server/token/certs) to create pods and stream logs or wait for completion, and run kubectl-style apply/get/patch/delete/restart commands with namespace, context, and resource selectors.

body.name: core
body.title: Kubernetes Core
body.description: Tasks that create pods and manage core workload execution on Kubernetes.
body.body: Use PodCreate with connection settings, namespace, image, command, env, and volume mounts to launch jobs, stream logs, and wait for completion with configurable timeouts; ideal for running containerized steps inside workflows.

body.name: linkedin
body.title: LinkedIn
body.description: Tasks that authenticate with LinkedIn and fetch post analytics or comment triggers.
body.body: Use OAuth2 credentials to obtain LinkedIn access tokens, poll for new comments, and retrieve analytics for organization posts; configure organization URNs, post IDs, and auth secrets to drive social reporting workflows.

body.name: ee-git
body.title: Git (EE)
body.description: Enterprise Git tasks: clone, sync, commit, and push Kestra Apps, Blueprints, Unit Tests, and Dashboards with Git repositories.
body.body: Use these tasks to fetch resources from a branch, reconcile them with Kestra (or preview changes with `dryRun`), and push updates back to Git. Provide the repository `url`, credentials, target `branch`, and Git subdirectories.

body.name: kubectl
body.title: Kubernetes API (kubectl)
body.description: Tasks that perform kubectl-style apply, get, delete, patch, and restart operations.
body.body: Supply connection info plus manifests or resource identifiers to apply YAML, fetch resources, delete them, patch with merge/strategic/JSON patches, or restart deployments/statefulsets; supports namespace, context, label selectors, and dry-run flags.

body.name: malloy
body.title: Malloy CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute Malloy CLI queries.
body.body: Provide the Malloy model file or query, connection settings, and CLI options to run Malloy queries and capture the results or exported files inside Kestra flows.

body.name: meilisearch
body.title: Meilisearch
body.description: Tasks that load data into and query Meilisearch indexes.
body.body: Provide the Meilisearch host and API key to create or update indexes, push documents, configure settings, and search with filters, returning JSON results for downstream processing.

body.name: liquibase
body.title: Liquibase
body.description: Tasks that run Liquibase change management commands.
body.body: Provide database connection details and changelog files to run updates, diffs, rollbacks, validations, or status checks via Liquibase CLI options, returning output for deployment pipelines.

body.name: metaplane
body.title: Metaplane
body.description: Run and read data-observability monitors from Metaplane.

body.name: neo4j
body.title: Neo4j
body.description: Tasks that run Cypher queries against Neo4j.
body.body: Provide Neo4j URI/auth credentials and Cypher statements with parameters to read or write graph data, returning query results for analytics or lineage workflows.

body.name: n8n
body.title: n8n
body.description: Tasks that trigger n8n workflows from Kestra.
body.body: Configure n8n webhook URLs and optional auth headers to start n8n workflows and pass payloads from Kestra executions, enabling cross-orchestration between the two platforms.

body.name: matrix
body.title: Matrix
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Matrix rooms via a bot account.
body.body: Set your Matrix homeserver URL, bot access token, and target room ID to send messages from Kestra workflows to a Matrix room, or notify a room about a flow execution's result.

body.name: minio
body.title: MinIO
body.description: Tasks that interact with MinIO S3-compatible object storage.
body.body: Configure endpoint, access/secret keys, bucket, and region or path-style settings to upload/download objects, list prefixes, and integrate MinIO data with workflows.

body.name: opentofu
body.title: OpenTofu
body.description: Tasks that run OpenTofu CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
body.body: Run OpenTofu commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

body.name: cli
body.title: OpenToFu CLI
body.description: Tasks that run OpenTofu CLI commands to init, plan, apply, and destroy infrastructure.
body.body: Run OpenTofu commands inside a container with support for input files, output files, environment variables, and remote state backends such as S3, GCS, or Terraform Cloud.

body.name: flows
body.title: Kestra Flows
body.description: Tasks that list and export Kestra flows.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL, namespace filters, and auth token to retrieve flow definitions or export them (by namespace or ID) for backup, promotion, or analysis.

body.name: logs
body.title: Kestra Logs
body.description: Tasks that fetch logs from a Kestra instance.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to fetch execution logs for analysis or downstream processing.

body.name: monday
body.title: Monday
body.description: Drive Monday from a Kestra flow via its GraphQL API.
body.body: Plugin for Monday's GraphQL API, covering boards, groups, columns, items, subitems, comments, users, workspaces, webhooks, folders, teams, and notifications. Includes a generic query task as an escape hatch and a polling trigger that reacts to new or updated items.

body.name: odoo
body.title: Odoo
body.description: Tasks that call the Odoo XML-RPC API for ERP automation.
body.body: Provide the Odoo server URL, database, username, and password to authenticate, then run create, read, update, or search operations on models; include model name, fields, and filters to orchestrate ERP data from Kestra flows.

body.name: cases
body.title: Kestra Cases
body.description: Task to open or attach to Kestra EE incident-management Cases.
body.body: Use CreateCase from an errors: block to open an incident whenever a flow fails, or attach the triggering execution to an existing case.

body.name: boards
body.title: Miro Boards
body.description: Tasks for managing Miro boards: list, get, create, update, delete, and copy, plus a polling trigger for new boards.
body.body: Use these tasks to automate Miro board lifecycle management: provision boards for new projects, archive completed ones, and audit board membership from a Kestra flow.

body.name: miro
body.title: Miro
body.description: Tasks and triggers for managing Miro boards from Kestra flows.
body.body: Provide a Miro OAuth 2.0 bearer token to list, get, create, update, delete, and copy Miro boards, and to trigger flows when new boards are created.

body.name: modal
body.title: Modal
body.description: Tasks that run Modal workflows via the Modal CLI.
body.body: Use your Modal token and profile to execute Modal CLI commands from Kestra, letting you launch functions, manage deployments, or run images with captured output.

body.name: notion
body.title: Notion
body.description: Tasks that create, read, update, and archive Notion pages, and query and manage Notion database items.
body.body: Provide a Notion integration token and page/database IDs to create pages from markdown/blocks, read or update content, archive pages, query databases, and create or update database items.

body.name: query
body.title: Monday Query
body.description: Generic Monday GraphQL access.
body.body: Run an arbitrary Monday GraphQL query or mutation. Use this as an escape hatch when no dedicated task covers the operation.

body.name: roles
body.title: Kestra IAM Roles
body.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete IAM roles.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to upsert roles with specific permissions, list existing roles, or delete them by name, enabling automated role lifecycle management from orchestrated workflows.

body.name: kestra
body.title: Kestra Plugin
body.description: Tasks that interact with Kestra itself to manage flows, executions, namespaces, dashboards, and tests.
body.body: Point to a Kestra server URL with API token and namespace to query or kill executions, export or list flows, enumerate namespaces, export dashboard chart data, and run EE test suites directly from orchestrated workflows.

body.name: page
body.title: Notion Pages
body.description: Tasks that create, read, update, and archive Notion pages.
body.body: Use a Notion integration token with parent page or database IDs to render markdown into Notion blocks, retrieve page content, update properties, or archive pages, returning the updated Notion payloads.

body.name: items
body.title: Monday Items
body.description: Full lifecycle for items on a Monday board.
body.body: Full lifecycle for items on a Monday board: create, update, archive, delete, move, duplicate, and read. The polling trigger fires on new or updated items.

body.name: locks
body.title: Kestra Asset Locks
body.description: Tasks to acquire and release execution-owned locks on Kestra EE data assets.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to acquire a time-bounded lock on an asset for the current execution, or release a lock this execution owns.

body.name: cli
body.title: Modal CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute Modal CLI commands.
body.body: Provide Modal auth (token/profile) and the CLI command list to run functions or manage deployments from Kestra, capturing stdout/stderr and exit codes for orchestration.

body.name: ipam
body.title: phpIPAM IPAM
body.description: Tasks for managing IPAM resources (sections, subnets, IP addresses, VLANs, VRFs) via the phpIPAM REST API.

body.name: database
body.title: Notion Databases
body.description: Tasks that query and manage items in Notion databases.
body.body: Use a Notion integration token and database IDs to query database rows, create new items with typed properties, and update or archive existing items.

body.name: tests
body.title: Kestra Tests
body.description: Tasks that run Kestra Enterprise test suites.
body.body: Provide the Kestra EE API endpoint, namespace, and auth token to execute flow tests (single or batch), returning results and failures to gate promotions.

body.name: groups
body.title: Kestra IAM Groups
body.description: Tasks that create, list, delete, and manage members of IAM groups.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to upsert groups, enumerate them, remove them, or add and remove individual members, enabling automated group lifecycle management from orchestrated workflows.

body.name: assets
body.title: Monday Assets
body.description: Fetch Monday asset metadata and content.
body.body: Fetch and download Monday asset (file) metadata and content. Use it to inspect uploads attached to items or to stream binaries into Kestra internal storage for downstream processing.

body.name: phpipam
body.title: phpIPAM
body.description: Interact with a self-hosted phpIPAM instance to manage IP Address Management (IPAM) resources: sections, subnets, IP addresses, VLANs, and VRFs.

body.name: users
body.title: Monday Users
body.description: Look up Monday users.
body.body: List Monday users in the account and resolve the identity tied to the API token in use. Useful for looking up user ids before assigning items or sending notifications.

body.name: assets
body.title: Kestra Assets
body.description: Tasks and triggers to manage Kestra EE data assets.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to list, set, delete, and purge assets, or trigger on asset freshness.

body.name: groups
body.title: Monday Groups
body.description: Manage the labelled sections inside a Monday board.
body.body: Create, update, delete, archive, and duplicate the labelled sections (groups) inside a Monday board. Use them when scripting board layout or organising items into logical buckets.

body.name: bindings
body.title: Kestra IAM Bindings
body.description: Task that manages role bindings for users and service accounts.
body.body: Provide the Kestra API URL, auth token, and a subject (user or service account) with the desired roles to create or replace IAM role bindings in a namespace.

body.name: boards
body.title: Monday Boards
body.description: Manage Monday boards from a flow.
body.body: Create, get, query, update, delete, archive, and duplicate Monday boards. Useful for provisioning new boards or tearing down boards as part of an automated workflow.

body.name: teams
body.title: Monday Teams
body.description: Provision and manage Monday teams.
body.body: Create and delete Monday teams, and add or remove their members. Useful when provisioning accounts in bulk or mirroring an external directory.

body.name: updates
body.title: Monday Updates
body.description: Comment threads attached to Monday items.
body.body: Post, delete, and like the comment threads (updates) attached to a Monday item. Useful for narrating flow activity directly on the item that triggered it.

body.name: vlan
body.title: phpIPAM VLANs
body.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM VLANs (802.1Q VLAN records).

body.name: vrf
body.title: phpIPAM VRFs
body.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM VRFs (Virtual Routing and Forwarding instances).

body.name: executions
body.title: Kestra Executions
body.description: Tasks that query, delete, or kill Kestra executions.
body.body: Provide the Kestra API URL, auth token, and execution IDs or search parameters to list or query executions, delete them, or send kill requests, enabling meta-orchestration inside Kestra itself.

body.name: triggers
body.title: Kestra Triggers
body.description: Triggers that react to or monitor resources within a Kestra instance.
body.body: Use the Kestra API URL, authentication, and optional filters to monitor schedules, flows, namespaces, or other triggerable conditions and produce executions based on system state.

body.name: dashboards
body.title: Kestra Dashboards
body.description: Tasks that export Kestra dashboard chart data.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL, dashboard and chart identifiers, and auth token to export chart data as CSV or ION files, ready to attach to a scheduled report.

body.name: columns
body.title: Monday Columns
body.description: Define a Monday board's schema.
body.body: Create, rename, and delete the columns that make up a Monday board's schema. Use them when defining or evolving a board's structure programmatically.

body.name: folders
body.title: Monday Folders
body.description: Organise Monday workspace layout.
body.body: Create and delete folders inside Monday workspaces. Useful when scripting workspace layout or grouping boards under a common parent.

body.name: section
body.title: phpIPAM Sections
body.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM sections (logical groupings of subnets).

body.name: workspaces
body.title: Monday Workspaces
body.description: Top-level containers for Monday boards and folders.
body.body: Create, list, and delete the top-level workspaces that hold Monday boards and folders. Useful when bootstrapping a new tenant or tearing one down at the end of an environment lifecycle.

body.name: serviceAccounts
body.title: Kestra IAM Service Accounts
body.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete service accounts.
body.body: Provide the Kestra API URL and auth token to upsert service accounts by name, list all service accounts in a tenant, or delete them, enabling automated service account lifecycle management from orchestrated workflows.

body.name: subitems
body.title: Monday Subitems
body.description: Work with subitems nested under parent items.
body.body: Create a subitem nested under a parent Monday item, with optional column values. Use it when breaking a top-level item down into checklist-style children from a flow.

body.name: subnet
body.title: phpIPAM Subnets
body.description: Tasks for managing phpIPAM subnets, including search and first-free lookup.

body.name: invitations
body.title: Kestra IAM Invitations
body.description: Tasks that create, list, and delete user invitations.
body.body: Provide the Kestra API URL, auth token, and an email address with optional roles to send invitations, enumerate pending invitations, or revoke them before acceptance.

body.name: tenantAccess
body.title: Kestra IAM Tenant Access
body.description: Tasks that grant or revoke tenant-level access for users.
body.body: Set the Kestra API URL and auth token to assign or remove a user's access to the current tenant, enabling automated tenant membership management from orchestrated workflows.

body.name: address
body.title: phpIPAM Addresses
body.description: Tasks and triggers for managing phpIPAM IP address records.

body.name: webhooks
body.title: Monday Webhooks
body.description: Push Monday board events to an external endpoint.
body.body: Register and remove webhooks on a Monday board so external endpoints get pushed events. Use them to wire Monday board activity into a Kestra webhook trigger or another HTTP listener.

body.name: namespaces
body.title: Kestra Namespaces
body.description: Tasks that list namespaces and flows across a Kestra instance.
body.body: Configure the Kestra API endpoint and token to enumerate namespaces and optionally include flows within them, useful for governance or promotion pipelines.

body.name: notifications
body.title: Monday Notifications
body.description: Send in-app Monday notifications.
body.body: Send an in-app Monday notification to a user, tied to a target board, item, or project. Useful for alerting an owner from a flow without leaving the Monday inbox.

body.name: mongodb
body.title: MongoDB
body.description: Tasks that query and manipulate MongoDB collections.
body.body: Provide connection URI/credentials and database/collection names to run find, aggregate, insert, update, delete operations, returning JSON results for downstream processing.

body.name: remediation
body.title: Netskope Remediation
body.description: Action-oriented tasks for automated security response in Netskope Security Cloud, suitable for SOAR workflows.

body.name: events
body.title: Netskope Events
body.description: Tasks to fetch alerts, events, and audit logs from Netskope Security Cloud via the REST API v2 Data Export endpoint.

body.name: scim
body.title: Netskope SCIM
body.description: Tasks to manage user and group identity lifecycle in Netskope Security Cloud via SCIM 2.0.

body.name: netskope
body.title: Netskope
body.description: Netskope Security Cloud plugin for Kestra

body.name: opsgenie
body.title: Atlassian Opsgenie
body.description: Tasks that create alerts in Opsgenie.
body.body: Provide the Opsgenie API endpoint and integration key, along with message, priority, responders, and tags to open alerts from Kestra flows and receive response payloads.

body.name: cli
body.title: Ollama CLI
body.description: Tasks that execute Ollama CLI commands for model management and generation.
body.body: Define the shell `commands` to run (pull, list, run), optionally set a remote `host`, container image, and model caching path, and capture output files so model runs and assets integrate cleanly with workflows.

body.name: pinecone
body.title: Pinecone
body.description: Interact with Pinecone, a managed vector database, from your Kestra workflows. Create serverless indexes, upsert vectors, query by similarity, fetch or delete vectors by ID, and inspect index statistics.

body.name: ollama
body.title: Ollama
body.description: Tasks that work with Ollama models and runtime features.
body.body: Use these tasks to run Ollama models locally or on a remote host, supplying the model name, prompt, and optional server host so completions or model management commands can be orchestrated inside Kestra.

body.name: pipedrive-deals
body.title: Pipedrive Deals
body.description: Tasks that create, retrieve, update, list, and delete deals in Pipedrive.
body.body: Provide the Pipedrive `apiToken` along with deal fields such as `title`, `value`, `currency`, and pipeline/stage IDs to insert, fetch, filter, or modify deals and capture the returned deal payload for further automation. Deleting a deal only soft-deletes it in Pipedrive; use `Update` with `status: 'won'` or `status: 'lost'` for the normal close-out workflow instead.

body.name: pipedrive-persons
body.title: Pipedrive Persons
body.description: Tasks that create, retrieve, update, list, and delete persons in Pipedrive.
body.body: Use your `apiToken` to add, retrieve, update, filter, or remove person records with properties like `name`, `email`, `phone`, and organization IDs, returning the contact data for enrichment or downstream syncing.

body.name: pipedrive
body.title: Pipedrive
body.description: Tasks that manage Pipedrive deals and persons.
body.body: Authenticate with your Pipedrive `apiToken` (and optional `apiUrl`) to create or update deals and create or fetch people records, returning the API payloads for routing to CRM or reporting steps.

body.name: perplexity
body.title: Perplexity
body.description: Tasks that request chat completions from Perplexity models.
body.body: Set your Perplexity API key, choose the target model, and pass in messages or prompts to generate responses with usage details you can log or feed into downstream steps.

body.name: pylon
body.title: Pylon
body.description: Create, update, and reply to Pylon support tickets, and react to new or updated ones with a polling trigger.
body.body: Manage Pylon support issues (tickets) from a Kestra flow: create, fetch, list, and update issues, post customer-facing replies or internal notes, and trigger a flow when an issue is created or updated.

body.name: pylon-issue
body.title: Pylon Issues
body.description: Tasks and a trigger for creating, listing, updating, and replying to Pylon support issues (tickets).
body.body: Create, fetch, list, and update Pylon issues; post customer-facing replies or internal notes; and react to new or updated issues with a polling trigger.

body.name: powerbi
body.title: Power BI
body.description: Tasks that refresh Microsoft Power BI datasets via the API.
body.body: Provide Azure tenant/client credentials and specify the Power BI group and dataset IDs to trigger refreshes and list refresh history, returning API responses for reporting pipelines.

body.name: pulsar
body.title: Apache Pulsar
body.description: Tasks that publish, consume, and trigger workflows with Apache Pulsar.
body.body: Provide Pulsar service URLs and auth settings to produce messages, consume topics or subscriptions with ack/receiver options, and use triggers to start flows when new messages arrive.

body.name: cli
body.title: Redis CLI
body.description: Execute Redis CLI commands directly using the official Redis Docker image.
body.body: Run any redis-cli command in a Docker container. Supports authentication, TLS, database selection, and JSON output format (Redis 7+). Commands are executed sequentially and the task fails if any command fails.

body.name: json
body.title: Redis JSON
body.description: Tasks that store and retrieve JSON documents in Redis.
body.body: Configure Redis connection info and JSON paths to set, get, and update JSON values using RedisJSON commands, enabling structured data storage from workflows.

body.name: pagerduty
body.title: PagerDuty
body.description: Tasks that send events to PagerDuty.
body.body: Provide a PagerDuty routing/integration key with summary, source, severity, and optional custom details to trigger incidents or alerts from Kestra workflows.

body.name: resend
body.title: Resend
body.description: Tasks that manage domains and send email via the Resend API.
body.body: Provide your Resend API key to verify domains and send emails with from/to, subject, HTML/text bodies, and optional tags or attachments, returning API responses for deliverability tracking.

body.name: email
body.title: Resend Email
body.description: Tasks that send emails using the Resend API.
body.body: Set the Resend API key, sender, recipients, subject, and HTML/text content (plus optional tags and attachments) to deliver emails from Kestra workflows and capture message IDs/status.

body.name: prometheus
body.title: Prometheus
body.description: Tasks that query Prometheus and push custom metrics.
body.body: Provide the Prometheus server URL and PromQL queries to fetch time-series data or use the pushgateway settings to publish metrics; triggers can poll PromQL results and start flows when conditions match.

body.name: vector
body.title: Redis Vector
body.description: Tasks that store and query embeddings in Redis vector sets.
body.body: Configure Redis connection info and use VADD/VSIM/VREM to add embeddings to a vector set, run KNN similarity search, and remove elements, enabling similarity search and RAG pipelines directly against Redis.

body.name: redis
body.title: Redis
body.description: Tasks that work with Redis data structures and pub/sub.
body.body: Provide Redis connection details (host, port, TLS, credentials) to read/write strings and lists, store JSON, or publish/subscribe to channels, enabling cache and queue patterns in workflows.

body.name: pubsub
body.title: Redis PubSub
body.description: Tasks that publish and subscribe to Redis channels.
body.body: Configure Redis connection, channel names, and payloads to publish messages or subscribe with triggers that start flows when messages are received.

body.name: string
body.title: Redis String
body.description: Tasks that read and write Redis string keys.
body.body: Provide Redis connection info and keys/values to SET/GET or increment/decrement strings, enabling simple cache or counter patterns in workflows.

body.name: list
body.title: Redis List
body.description: Tasks that push, pop, and read Redis lists.
body.body: Provide Redis connection settings and list keys to LPUSH/RPUSH, LPOP/RPOP, range, or trim lists so workflows can use Redis as a queue or buffer.

body.name: domain
body.title: Resend Domain
body.description: Tasks that manage and verify domains with the Resend API.
body.body: Use your Resend API key to add domains, retrieve verification records, and check domain status so you can enable sending from trusted domains.

body.name: tcp
body.title: TCP
body.description: Tasks that send and receive data over TCP sockets with optional triggers.
body.body: Specify host/port, payload, framing, and timeout settings to write or read raw TCP data, or start a TCP server trigger to capture inbound messages and launch workflows with the received content.

body.name: udp
body.title: UDP
body.description: Tasks that send and receive datagrams over UDP with optional triggers.
body.body: Set target host/port, payload, buffer size, and timeout options to send or listen for UDP packets, and use the trigger mode to start flows when datagrams are received.

body.name: ssh
body.title: SSH (Secure Shell)
body.description: Tasks that run commands over SSH and handle files on remote hosts.
body.body: Configure host/port with username and password or private key, and optional known-hosts handling, to execute commands or transfer files via SSH, capturing outputs and exit codes for orchestration.

body.name: nfs
body.title: NFS
body.description: Tasks that read and write files on Network File System (NFS) mounts.
body.body: Mount your NFS path in the worker and supply source/target paths to list, upload, download, move, or delete files, letting flows exchange data with shared NFS volumes.

body.name: smb
body.title: SMB (Server Message Block)
body.description: Tasks that exchange files over SMB/CIFS shares.
body.body: Set the SMB share URL, domain/user credentials, and remote/local paths to list, upload, download, move, or delete files; supports NTLM auth options so workflows can interact with Samba or Windows shares.

body.name: ftp
body.title: FTP (File Transfer Protocol)
body.description: Tasks that list, transfer, move, delete, and watch files over FTP.
body.body: Provide FTP host/port, username/password (and passive/binary options) with remote and local paths to upload or download single or multiple files, move or delete them, and use the trigger to start flows when new files arrive.

body.name: local
body.title: Local
body.description: Tasks that manipulate files on the local file system.
body.body: Use local path inputs to upload, download, list, copy, move, or delete files and enable the polling trigger to react to new or modified files in directories.

body.name: sftp
body.title: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol)
body.description: Tasks that manage files over SFTP with SSH authentication.
body.body: Provide host/port plus username and password or private key, then list, upload, download, move, or delete files and enable triggers for new remote files using remote/local paths and optional host key settings.

body.name: ftps
body.title: FTPS (File Transfer Protocol Secure)
body.description: Tasks that transfer and manage files over FTPS with TLS.
body.body: Configure FTPS host/port, credentials, and security mode (implicit or explicit) with certificate settings to list, upload, download, move, or delete files and trigger flows on new arrivals using the provided paths.

body.name: apps
body.title: Argo CD Apps
body.description: GitOps-focused tasks that sync, inspect, patch or manage the lifecycle of an Argo CD application via the Argo CD CLI. Use `Sync` to apply the desired GitOps Git state, `Status` to read sync/health, conditions, and resources, `Patch` to update the application spec, `Create` to declare a new application, and `Delete` to remove one.
body.body: Use `Sync` to apply the desired GitOps Git state (supports prune/dry-run/force plus optional revision and timeout), `Status` to read sync/health, conditions, and resources (optionally with `refresh`), `Patch` to update the application spec with a JSON or merge patch, `Create` to declare an application from a Git repository or from an Application manifest, and `Delete` to remove an application with or without its cluster resources. All tasks need the Argo CD `server`, `token`, and `application` along with optional TLS/connection flags (`insecure`, `plaintext`, `grpcWeb`, `serverCert`) and CLI image/version overrides.

body.name: fs
body.title: File system
body.description: Tasks that manage files across local and remote file systems.
body.body: Use protocol-specific tasks (local, FTP/FTPS/SFTP, NFS, SMB, SSH, TCP/UDP) to list, upload, download, move, copy, delete, and watch files by providing host/port, credentials or keys, and source/target paths; triggers detect new or updated files.

body.name: argocd
body.title: Argo CD
body.description: GitOps-focused tasks that interact with Argo CD using the Argo CD CLI. Tasks are executed inside a container and rely on the official Argo CD CLI to perform application synchronization, status inspection, spec patching and application lifecycle management.

body.name: infoblox
body.title: Infoblox (EE)
body.description: Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) tasks and triggers for Kestra, covering both NIOS Grid Manager (WAPI REST API) and Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal API).
body.body: Automate Infoblox NIOS Grid Manager: manage IPv4/IPv6 networks, fixed addresses, DHCP ranges, DNS A/AAAA/CNAME/PTR/host records, list DHCP leases, and trigger flows on IP allocation events. Automate Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal): manage IP spaces, address blocks, subnets, addresses, DHCP ranges and fixed addresses, authoritative zones, and type-discriminated DNS records under the `csp.*` tasks.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-lease
body.title: Infoblox DHCP Leases
body.description: Tasks to list DHCP leases in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List DHCP lease objects in Infoblox. Leases are read-only in WAPI.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-range
body.title: Infoblox DHCP Ranges
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 DHCP ranges in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv4 DHCP range objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-address
body.title: Infoblox IPv4 Addresses
body.description: Tasks to list and allocate IPv4 addresses in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List used IPv4 addresses, allocate the next available IP from a network, and release fixed address assignments.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-trigger
body.title: Infoblox Triggers
body.description: Polling triggers for Infoblox IPAM events via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: Trigger flows on IPv4 or IPv6 address allocation and release events in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-ipv6range
body.title: Infoblox IPv6 DHCP Ranges
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 DHCP ranges in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, and delete IPv6 DHCP range objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-dns-hostrecord
body.title: Infoblox DNS Host Records
body.description: Tasks to manage DNS host records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS host record objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-dns-cnamerecord
body.title: Infoblox DNS CNAME Records
body.description: Tasks to manage DNS CNAME records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS CNAME record objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-ipv6address
body.title: Infoblox IPv6 Addresses
body.description: Tasks to list and allocate IPv6 addresses in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List used IPv6 addresses, allocate the next available IPv6 from a network, and release IPv6 fixed address assignments.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-dns-aaaarecord
body.title: Infoblox DNS AAAA Records
body.description: Tasks to manage DNS AAAA records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS AAAA record objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-dns-ptrrecord
body.title: Infoblox DNS PTR Records
body.description: Tasks to manage DNS PTR records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS PTR record objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-dns-arecord
body.title: Infoblox DNS A Records
body.description: Tasks to manage DNS A records in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS A record objects in Infoblox.

body.name: dynamics365-dataverse
body.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Dataverse
body.description: Tasks that interact with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Dataverse for OData entity operations.
body.body: Configure the `orgUrl` and Azure authentication properties to query, upsert, and delete Dataverse entity records using the OData v9.2 API.

body.name: debezium-sqlserver
body.title: Debezium Microsoft SQL Server
body.description: Tasks that stream Microsoft SQL Server change data capture events into Kestra with Debezium.
body.body: Capture plus batch and real-time triggers use the Debezium SQL Server connector to feed CDC rows into Kestra. Provide hostname/port, credentials, target `database`, snapshotMode, and include/exclude filters; Trigger batches results with maxRecords/duration controls, while RealtimeTrigger fires one execution per change.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-networkview
body.title: Infoblox Network Views
body.description: Tasks to manage network views in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, and delete network view objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-fixedaddress
body.title: Infoblox Fixed Addresses
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 fixed address reservations in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv4 fixed address objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-csp-dns-record
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DNS Records
body.description: Tasks to manage the unified, type-discriminated DNS record object (dns/record) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DNS records. Universal DDI unifies A, AAAA, CNAME, PTR, TXT, MX, NS, and SRV into one object discriminated by a `type` field, unlike NIOS's per-type record objects.

body.name: infoblox-csp-ipam-address
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Addresses
body.description: Tasks to manage addresses (ipam/address) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List addresses, allocate the next available address from a subnet or address block, and release reservations.

body.name: infoblox-csp-ipam-subnet
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Subnets
body.description: Tasks to manage subnets (ipam/subnet) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, get, create, update, and delete subnet objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS leaf network.

body.name: infoblox-csp-ipam-ipspace
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI IP Spaces
body.description: Tasks to manage IP spaces (ipam/ip_space) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, and delete IP space objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS network view.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-ipv6fixedaddress
body.title: Infoblox IPv6 Fixed Addresses
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 fixed address reservations in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, and delete IPv6 fixed address objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-csp-dns-authzone
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Authoritative Zones
body.description: Tasks to manage authoritative DNS zones (dns/auth_zone) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, and delete authoritative DNS zone objects.

body.name: infoblox-csp-ipam-range
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DHCP Ranges
body.description: Tasks to manage DHCP ranges (ipam/range) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, update, and delete DHCP range objects.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-ipv6network
body.title: Infoblox IPv6 Networks
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv6 networks in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, create, update, and delete IPv6 network objects in Infoblox.

body.name: infoblox-ipam-network
body.title: Infoblox Networks
body.description: Tasks to manage IPv4 networks in Infoblox via the WAPI REST API.
body.body: List, get, create, update, and delete IPv4 network objects in Infoblox.

body.name: ruby
body.title: Ruby - GraalVM
body.description: Tasks that execute Ruby with GraalVM.
body.body: Run inline Ruby or script files inside the GraalVM engine with optional bindings and input parameters, returning computed results directly to your workflows.

body.name: debezium-mysql
body.title: Debezium MySQL
body.description: Tasks that ingest MySQL change data capture streams in Kestra using Debezium.
body.body: Capture, Trigger, and RealtimeTrigger rely on the Debezium MySQL connector to write CDC records to Kestra storage and start flows. Configure hostname/port, credentials, a unique `serverId`, snapshotMode, and any include/exclude filters; use Trigger to batch events with maxRecords/duration controls or RealtimeTrigger for one execution per row.

body.name: js
body.title: JS - GraalVM
body.description: Tasks that execute JavaScript with GraalVM.
body.body: Pass inline JS or script files with optional bindings and parameters to run inside the GraalVM engine, returning transformed content or computed results for workflows.

body.name: python
body.title: Python - GraalVM
body.description: Tasks that execute Python with GraalVM.
body.body: Provide inline Python code or script files and optional bindings/parameters to run inside GraalVM, emitting transformed outputs or data back into Kestra flows without an external interpreter.

body.name: debezium-mongodb
body.title: Debezium MongoDB
body.description: Tasks that stream MongoDB change events into Kestra through Debezium connectors.
body.body: Includes Capture plus batch and real-time triggers to ingest MongoDB change data into Kestra flows. Provide a replica set or sharded `connectionString` with credentials, choose snapshotMode, and optionally include or exclude collections; use Trigger to poll in batches or RealtimeTrigger to fire one execution per change.

body.name: graalvm
body.title: GraalVM
body.description: Tasks that run JS, Python, or Ruby code via the GraalVM engine.
body.body: Provide inline scripts or file paths with language selection, optional bindings/variables, and output handling to execute GraalVM code inside workflows while capturing logs and results.

body.name: infoblox-csp-dhcp-fixedaddress
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI DHCP Fixed Addresses
body.description: Tasks to manage DHCP fixed-address reservations in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, and delete DHCP fixed-address reservations, implemented as ipam/address objects tagged kestra_fixed=true since Universal DDI has no dedicated fixed-address endpoint in its public API surface.

body.name: infoblox-csp-ipam-addressblock
body.title: Infoblox Universal DDI Address Blocks
body.description: Tasks to manage address blocks (ipam/address_block) in Infoblox Universal DDI (Cloud Services Portal).
body.body: List, create, update, and delete address block objects, the Universal DDI equivalent of a NIOS container network.

body.name: kafka
body.title: Apache Kafka
body.description: Tasks that produce, consume, and trigger workflows from Apache Kafka topics, including share-group queue semantics.
body.body: Set bootstrap servers, topic names, and serializers along with security settings (SASL/SSL) to publish messages, poll or stream consumes, and use triggers to start flows on new records. Consume and trigger tasks support both classic consumer groups and share groups for queue-style processing.

body.name: debezium-postgres
body.title: Debezium PostgreSQL
body.description: Tasks that capture PostgreSQL logical replication changes via Debezium for Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use Capture plus batch and real-time triggers built on the Debezium PostgreSQL connector to move WAL changes into Kestra. Set database, logical decoding `pluginName`, `publicationName`, and `slotName`, pick snapshotMode, and optionally TLS settings; choose Trigger for batched polling or RealtimeTrigger to emit an execution per change.

body.name: debezium-oracle
body.title: Debezium Oracle
body.description: Tasks that capture Oracle database change events through Debezium for Kestra flows.
body.body: Capture, Trigger, and RealtimeTrigger run the Debezium Oracle connector to stream redo log changes into Kestra. Supply hostname/port, credentials, the database `sid` (and optional `pluggableDatabase` for CDB setups), pick snapshotMode, and apply include/exclude filters; use Trigger to batch records by maxRecords/durations or RealtimeTrigger for per-row executions.

body.name: microsoft365
body.title: Microsoft 365
body.description: Tasks that integrate Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 services.
body.body: Authenticate with Microsoft Graph or Azure AD (tenant, client ID/secret or certificate) once and reuse the connection to manage Outlook mail, OneDrive/SharePoint files, Dataverse entities, and Business Central financials directly from Kestra workflows.

body.name: debezium-db2
body.title: Debezium DB2
body.description: Tasks that ingest IBM Db2 change data through Debezium connectors in Kestra.
body.body: Includes Capture plus batch and real-time triggers that stream Db2 CDC events into Kestra via Debezium. Configure hostname/port, credentials, target `database`, snapshotMode, and include/exclude filters; Trigger polls and batches records up to maxRecords/duration settings while RealtimeTrigger emits an execution per change.

body.name: microsoft-fabric
body.title: Microsoft Fabric
body.description: Integrate with Microsoft Fabric services including Data Pipelines, OneLake, Data Engineering, and Warehouse within Kestra workflows.

body.name: data-engineering
body.title: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering
body.description: Tasks to run Pipelines, Notebooks, and Spark Job Definitions in Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering.

body.name: onelake
body.title: Microsoft Fabric OneLake
body.description: Tasks to upload, download, and delete files in Microsoft Fabric OneLake using the ADLS Gen2 API.

body.name: warehouse
body.title: Microsoft Fabric Warehouse
body.description: Tasks to query Microsoft Fabric Warehouse using SQL over JDBC.

body.name: mistral
body.title: Mistral
body.description: Tasks and triggers for Mistral AI: chat completions and workflow orchestration.
body.body: Provide your Mistral API key to generate chat completions, run Mistral Workflow executions, or react to Mistral workflow events — all from within orchestrated Kestra flows.

body.name: prefect
body.title: Prefect
body.description: Tasks that trigger Prefect deployments and monitor flow runs.
body.body: Configure the Prefect API URL with Cloud account/workspace IDs or self-hosted credentials, supply the `deploymentId`, and optionally wait with polling to return run status and IDs for orchestration.

body.name: dynamics365-businesscentral
body.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
body.description: Tasks that interact with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for finance and operations.
body.body: Configure the `environment`, tenant ID, and Azure authentication properties to manage companies, customers, sales invoices, and items via the Business Central API v2.0.

body.name: cli
body.title: dbt CLI
body.description: Tasks that run dbt via the CLI for building, testing, and managing projects.
body.body: Wraps dbt commands (build, run, test, compile, seed, snapshot, deps, etc.) using container or custom task runners so you can orchestrate dbt projects alongside the rest of your Kestra pipeline—refresh models before downstream loads, validate data, or publish docs. Lets you provide project directories, a dbt binary path, profiles, and environment variables. Supports fail-fast, warn-error, run-result parsing, and storing artifacts for downstream steps.

body.name: cloud
body.title: dbt Cloud
body.description: Tasks that trigger and monitor dbt Cloud jobs through the API.
body.body: Use these tasks to start jobs, poll run state, and download artifacts like run_results.json and manifest.json. Requires baseUrl, accountId, token, and jobId or runId, with options to override git refs, targets, timeouts, and wait for completion while streaming logs and parsed run results.

body.name: outlook
body.title: Microsoft Outlook
body.description: Tasks that send and read Outlook email and trigger workflows on new messages.
body.body: Provide Microsoft Graph credentials and a mailbox user principal to send mail, list or fetch messages (including attachments), and use the polling trigger to start flows on new arrivals; configure optional folder filters, search queries, and attachment handling.

body.name: adaptivecards
body.title: Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards
body.description: Tasks that send Microsoft Adaptive Cards to Teams channels and chats via the Microsoft Graph API.
body.body: Use the same Azure AD app registration as other Microsoft 365 tasks to post rich, interactive Adaptive Cards to any Teams channel or user chat and get back the message ID, instead of relying on a static incoming webhook URL.

body.name: teams
body.title: Microsoft Teams
body.description: Tasks that send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
body.body: Provide the Teams incoming webhook URL and message payload (text or cards) to post alerts from Kestra flows into Teams channels. For sending rich Adaptive Cards to a specific channel or user via the Microsoft Graph API instead of a webhook, see the `teams.adaptivecards` sub-package.

body.name: sharepoint
body.title: Microsoft SharePoint
body.description: Tasks that interact with SharePoint document libraries for file operations.
body.body: Set the SharePoint `siteId` and drive or item paths along with Graph authentication to list, upload, export, download, or delete files, reusing the shared Microsoft 365 connection for consistent permissions and auditability.

body.name: oneshare
body.title: MicrosoftOneShare
body.description: Tasks that manage OneDrive/SharePoint files with a unified interface and trigger on file changes.
body.body: Use Graph credentials with drive or site identifiers to list, upload, export, download, or delete files and enable the polling trigger to react to create/update events; ensure `driveId`/`itemPath` and permissions are set for the target library.

body.name: dbt
body.title: dbt
body.description: Integrate dbt data transformations into Kestra orchestration pipelines.
body.body: Provides dbt integrations for both CLI-driven projects and dbt Cloud jobs so you can orchestrate runs alongside other Kestra tasks. Supply your dbt profiles or Cloud API credentials to execute, monitor, and collect manifests and run results for downstream automation.

body.name: core
body.title: Datagen Core
body.description: Tasks that generate synthetic records on demand or emit them continuously.
body.body: Use `Generate` for inline values or batches stored in internal storage, `Trigger` for interval-based batches, and `RealtimeTrigger` for streaming at a controlled throughput. These generator-based tasks each need a `generator` (JSON, string, or bytes); key controls include `store` (defaults false), `batchSize` (defaults 1), `throughput`, `reportingInterval`, and `maxRecords` for caps. `Pseudonymize` is different: it reads an existing CSV, JSON, or ION file and replaces the listed PII fields with realistic fake values instead of generating new records.

body.name: ldap
body.title: LDAP
body.description: Tasks that query and modify LDAP directories.
body.body: Provide LDAP server URL, bind DN/password, and base DN to search entries, add/modify attributes, or delete objects, enabling identity data automation from Kestra.

body.name: mqtt
body.title: MQTT
body.description: Tasks that publish, subscribe, and trigger workflows with MQTT.
body.body: Set the broker URI, client ID, topics, QoS, and credentials to send or receive MQTT messages, with triggers that start flows when subscribed messages arrive.

body.name: core
body.title: NATS Core
body.description: Tasks that publish and subscribe to NATS subjects with triggers.
body.body: Configure NATS servers, authentication (user/password, token, or creds), subjects, and payload serialization to send messages or start flows when messages arrive, with consumer options for durable names and ack handling.

body.name: nats
body.title: NATS
body.description: Tasks that publish, subscribe, and work with NATS messaging.
body.body: Provide NATS server URLs and credentials/creds files to publish messages, consume subjects with triggers, and manage KV stores for lightweight state inside Kestra workflows.

body.name: kv
body.title: NATS KV
body.description: Tasks that interact with NATS key-value buckets.
body.body: Provide NATS connection settings, bucket names, keys, and values to put, get, list, or delete entries, enabling lightweight state sharing across workflows.

body.name: as400
body.title: AS400
body.description: Tasks that connect to AS400 via JDBC to run queries and loads.
body.body: Provide the AS400 JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

body.name: datagen
body.title: Datagen
body.description: Tasks that produce synthetic data payloads for triggering and exercising Kestra workflows.
body.body: Use Datagen to simulate events without external sources by pairing core tasks or triggers with JSON, string, or byte generators. Configure a generator (`value` template or `size`) and optionally batch and store results so downstream tasks can read generated files from Kestra storage.

body.name: generators
body.title: Generators
body.description: Reusable generators for JSON objects, strings, or random byte payloads that can be referenced across Datagen tasks.
body.body: Generators plug into Datagen tasks and triggers to emit structured or raw data. Use templates for `JsonObjectGenerator` or `StringValueGenerator` (Pebble + Datafaker expressions, optional locale list using Faker defaults when empty) or set the `size` for random byte arrays, then reference the generator in a core task.

body.name: dremio
body.title: Dremio
body.description: Tasks that connect to Dremio via JDBC to run queries and loads.
body.body: Provide the Dremio JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

body.name: db2
body.title: DB2

body.body: Provide the DB2 JDBC URL, credentials, and SQL statements (query, batch, load, trigger) to read or write data; configure fetch type, fetch size, and output options to return rows or files from workflows.

body.name: clickhouse
body.title: Clickhouse

body.name: oracle

body.title: Kubernetes Runner
body.description: Tasks that execute and orchestrate workloads as Kubernetes pods.
body.body: Configure the Kubernetes task runner on your tasks to launch containers per execution with optional working-directory sync, input/output file transfer, and pod resume handling after worker restarts.
